records.title: EQT Infrastructure acquires Reload via Scale Microgrids (bolt-on)
records.description: Scale Microgrids, backed by EQT Transition Infrastructure, acquired Reload, a Chicago-based platform that sites, designs, and permits gigawatt-scale data center campuses paired with rapidly deployable on-site power infrastructure. The acquisition expands Scale's growing data center business and is supported by a material capital commitment from EQT to deploy multi-gigawatts of capacity for hyperscale data center growth.

records.title: DWS Infrastructure acquires Cleanwatts from Verdane
records.description: An infrastructure fund managed by DWS acquired 100% of Portuguese renewable energy communities platform Cleanwatts from Verdane. As part of the transaction, DWS committed approximately €150mm by 2030 to scale Cleanwatts' decentralized solar and energy communities model, which provides commercial and residential users with shared solar generation with no upfront capital costs.

records.title: Equitix leads growth equity investment in Andion CH4 Renewables
records.description: Equitix led a considerable equity contribution into Andion CH4 Renewables, a European biogas developer, owner, and operator, alongside a €67mm private credit facility provided by Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The financing will accelerate the development of Andion's short-term pipeline of biomethane projects across Italy and the Nordic region.

records.title: Equitix acquires Cella Dati biomethane plant via Andion CH4 Renewables (bolt-on)
records.description: Andion CH4 Renewables, a European biomethane platform backed by Equitix's Next Generation Fund, announced a binding agreement to acquire 100% of the share capital of the Cella Dati biomethane plant from IREN and Santini Agricoltura Rinnovabile. The acquisition adds immediate operating capacity to Andion's expanding footprint in Italy.

records.title: Macquarie Asset Management / Nobian divest HyCC to Power2X

records.title: Stonepeak acquires 83 MW Indian solar portfolio via Digital Edge
records.description: Digital Edge, an APAC data center platform backed by Stonepeak, acquired a substantial minority equity stake in an 83 MW solar project portfolio from Hexa Climate Solutions. The direct investment into the renewable generation assets ensures captive user status under Indian regulations to power Digital Edge's BOM data center campus.

records.title: Exus Renewables acquires 60% stake in Masdar Portuguese wind portfolio
records.description: Exus Renewables agreed to acquire a 60% majority stake in a portfolio of nine operational wind farms in northern and central Portugal from Masdar, which will retain a 40% interest. The portfolio, located in Guarda and Castelo Branco, is undergoing one of Portugal's first large-scale repowering initiatives, increasing capacity from 144 MW to 164 MW with completion expected by 2027. The partnership also includes plans to co-develop 110 MW of solar hybridization across the sites.

records.title: CPP Investments and Equinix acquire controlling stake in atNorth from Partners Group
records.description: CPP Investments and Equinix signed a definitive joint agreement to acquire a controlling 60% equity stake in atNorth from Partners Group for a $4.0bn enterprise value. CPP Investments will commit approximately $1.6bn to the transaction, while Equinix takes 40%. Concurrently, Partners Group will reinvest for up to a 10% minority equity stake in the high-density, pan-Nordic colocation platform. The deal includes a provisionally agreed $4.2bn financing package.

records.title: Brookfield Asset Management launches Radiant AI infrastructure platform via Ori Industries acquisition
records.description: Brookfield Asset Management officially launched Radiant, a vertically integrated AI infrastructure company, through the acquisition and merger of UK-based distributed AI cloud provider Ori Industries. Valued at $1.3bn post-merger, Radiant serves as the first compute deployment vehicle for Brookfield's $10bn AI Infrastructure Fund (BAIIF). Built on the NVIDIA DSX reference design, Radiant will deliver utility-scale, purpose-built AI factories under long-term contracts.

records.title: Harrison Street divests Sandy Farms and Eternal Rings data centers
records.target: Sandy Farms & Eternal Rings Data Centers
records.description: Harrison Street sold two powered-shell data centers in the Baltimore, Maryland metro area to GI Partners for $221.9mm. The transaction includes the 109,455-square-foot Sandy Farms facility in Severn and the 110,336-square-foot Eternal Rings facility in Laurel. The acquisition by GI Partners was supported by a $113.4mm acquisition loan from Capital One Bank.

records.title: EQT Infrastructure acquires Skellefteå data center site via EdgeConneX (bolt-on)
records.description: EQT-backed EdgeConneX agreed to acquire a data center development site in Skellefteå, Sweden, from battery manufacturer Lyten. Co-located at the newly formed Lyten Industrial Hub at the former Northvolt Ett battery plant, the EdgeConneX campus has the potential to scale up to 1 GW of capacity. The facility will be primarily powered by local renewable hydroelectricity to support intensive AI and cloud computing workloads.

records.title: Tiger Infrastructure Partners acquires Digital Sense via 11:11 Systems (bolt-on)
records.description: Tiger Infrastructure Partners-backed 11:11 Systems acquired Digital Sense, a Brisbane-based cloud and managed services provider, from Aussie Broadband. The carve-out represents 11:11 Systems' seventh acquisition of a former VMware Cloud Service Provider and expands its sovereign cloud capabilities and footprint in the Australian and wider APAC markets.

records.title: Macquarie Asset Management / PGGM Infrastructure Fund / Australian Retirement Trust divest Macquarie AirFinance to Dubai Aerospace Enterprise
records.seller: Macquarie Asset Management / PGGM Infrastructure Fund / Australian Retirement Trust
records.description: Macquarie Asset Management announced the sale of its 50% stake in Macquarie AirFinance to Dubai Aerospace Enterprise. The seller consortium also included PGGM Infrastructure Fund and the Australian Retirement Trust.

records.title: Mainstay Maritime divests Lower Lakes Towing & 6 Canadian-flagged Lakers to Algoma Central
records.description: Mainstay Maritime agreed to sell its Canadian operating companies, including Lower Lakes Towing, to Algoma Central Corporation. The transaction includes six Canadian-flagged Laker vessels.

records.title: Stonepeak divests 49% stake in 321 Precision Conversions via ATSG
records.description: Air Transport Services Group (ATSG), an aviation logistics portfolio company recently taken private by Stonepeak, sold its 49% minority stake in 321 Precision Conversions to its joint venture partner, Erickson Group Ltd. The JV was formed in 2017 to engineer passenger-to-freighter conversions for Airbus A321 aircraft. The divestiture gives Erickson full ownership of the business as ATSG refocuses on core aircraft leasing operations.

records.title: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners exits DTG Recycle investment
records.description: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners exited its investment in DTG Recycle, Washington State's largest independent vertically integrated construction and demolition (C&D) waste recycling business. Founder Dan Guimont repurchased the core operations, while select Pierce County assets, including a C&D recycling facility in Tacoma, were divested to Waste Connections.

records.title: Bimergen Energy acquires 79.2 MW ERCOT South BESS portfolio from Aggreko IPP Solutions
records.seller: I Squared Capital (via Aggreko IPP Solutions)
records.description: Bimergen Energy completed the acquisition of a 79.2 MW distributed generation battery energy storage portfolio in ERCOT South from Aggreko's IPP Solutions business, which is owned by I Squared Capital.

records.title: Stonepeak invests in Aura Holdings retirement living platform
records.description: Stonepeak made a platform equity investment in Aura Holdings, a vertically integrated retirement living developer and operator based in Brisbane, Australia. Aura develops medium to high-end retirement living communities on premium sites throughout South-East Queensland and Northern New South Wales, with a pipeline of 2,000+ apartments over five years across six operational villages.

records.title: EQT Infrastructure and GIP co-lead take-private acquisition of AES Corporation
records.description: EQT Infrastructure and Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), a BlackRock company, jointly agreed to acquire AES Corporation in a take-private transaction. AES is a diversified power generation and utility company operating across multiple markets globally with significant renewable energy and conventional power assets.

records.title: HarbourVest Partners acquires stake in Calisen from Equitix
records.description: HarbourVest Partners acquired a stake in Calisen via a secondary transaction from Equitix, the UK smart metering platform.

records.title: Macquarie Asset Management divests minority stake in Arqiva
records.description: Macquarie Asset Management divested a minority stake in Arqiva, the UK's sole national provider of terrestrial television and radio broadcast infrastructure. Arqiva operates the transmission network delivering Freeview, DAB digital radio, and mobile connectivity services across the United Kingdom.

records.title: GIP divests 11.4% minority stake in Naturgy Energy Group SA
records.description: Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), a BlackRock company, divested its 11.4% minority stake in Naturgy Energy Group SA, the Spanish integrated utility. The sale was executed via the public market, reducing GIP's long-standing position in the Madrid-listed energy group.

records.title: Brookfield Infrastructure Structured Solutions / Telia acquire stake in Valokuitunen Oy from CapMan Infra
records.description: CapMan Infra agreed to sell its 60% stake in Valokuitunen Oy to Brookfield Infrastructure Structured Solutions (51%) and Telia (9%), Finland's leading fiber-to-the-home company.

records.title: Actis / Levanta Renewables acquire 80% stake in Gia Lai 50 MW onshore wind project from Super Energy
records.description: Levanta Renewables, backed by Actis, acquired an 80% stake in a 50 MW operating onshore wind farm in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam from Super Energy Corporation.

records.title: Thames Clippers / Northleaf Capital acquire Gosport Ferry from FIH Group

records.title: BCI / NBIM / Brookfield launch Northview Energy platform
records.description: BCI, Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM), and Brookfield launched Northview Energy, a renewable energy platform focused on North America.

records.title: Macquarie Asset Management / Gabia launch Gabia Data Centre JV platform
records.description: Macquarie Asset Management, through MAIF4, and Gabia Inc. announced a strategic partnership to develop a hyperscale data center platform in South Korea.

records.title: DWS Infrastructure acquires Maaselänkangas onshore wind farm from wpd Group
records.description: DWS Group acquired the Maaselänkangas onshore wind farm in Oulainen, Finland from wpd Group on behalf of its European infrastructure investment strategy. The facility comprises seven Nordex turbines with 41.3 MW of installed capacity, has been operational since September 2024, and is expected to generate approximately 128.6 GWh of annual net energy output.

records.title: Allianz Global Investors acquires 50% stake in 11 German BESS Projects from TotalEnergies
records.description: TotalEnergies agreed to sell a 50% stake in 11 battery energy storage projects under construction in Germany to Allianz Global Investors via its Kyon Energy subsidiary.

records.title: GIP acquires 71% stake in TCR from 3i Infrastructure in secondary buyout
records.description: Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), a BlackRock company, acquired a 71% controlling stake in TCR from 3i Infrastructure in a secondary buyout. TCR is a leading provider of ground support equipment (GSE) leasing and management services to the global aviation industry, operating across major airports worldwide.

records.title: KKR acquires 43.5% minority stake in SK Eternix from SK Discovery / Hahn & Company
records.description: KKR agreed to acquire a combined 43.5% minority stake in SK Eternix from SK Discovery and Hahn & Company, a South Korean renewable energy platform.

records.title: Greencoat Renewables / Schroders Greencoat launch green digital infrastructure JV and acquire Drogheda Energy Park
records.description: Greencoat Renewables and Schroders Greencoat's SCSL Global Energy Infrastructure vehicle launched a 50:50 JV for green digital infrastructure, with Drogheda Energy Park as its inaugural investment.

records.title: Nuveen Infrastructure acquires 70.4 MWp Brandenburg solar park from Trianel
records.description: Nuveen's European Core Renewable Infrastructure Strategy fund acquired a 70.4 MWp solar park in Brandenburg, Germany from Trianel Energieprojekte, a subsidiary of municipal utility cooperative Trianel GmbH. The solar park, located along the Berlin-Halle railway line, was commissioned in April 2025 and meets EU Taxonomy requirements. Trianel, backed by 53 municipal shareholders, develops wind, solar, and battery storage projects across Germany and Austria.

records.title: Ara Partners acquires Gate City Power, Gate City Renewable Fuels, and JET from HF Capital
records.target: Gate City Power / Gate City Renewable Fuels / JET
records.description: Ara Energy, a portfolio platform of Ara Partners, agreed to acquire Gate City Power, Gate City Renewable Fuels, and an interest in the JET retail network from HF Capital for approximately $875mm. Gate City Power owns thermal generation assets totaling approximately 2.2 GW across NYISO and ISO-NE, while Gate City Renewable Fuels comprises U.S. ethanol production assets; the JET retail network will be acquired in partnership with Ara Infrastructure.

records.title: Energy Capital Partners acquires TPI Composites wind blade operations via Section 363 sale
records.buyer: Energy Capital Partners (via ECP Blade Holdings)
records.description: Energy Capital Partners, through ECP Blade Holdings, agreed to acquire TPI Composites' global wind blade manufacturing and services operations via a Section 363 bankruptcy sale for $20mm in cash plus assumed liabilities. TPI, the only independent wind blade manufacturer with a global footprint, filed for Chapter 11 and secured $82.5mm in DIP financing as it navigates the restructuring process. The transaction is subject to bankruptcy court approval, Oaktree lender consent, and regulatory approvals, with a drop-dead date of June 30, 2026.

records.title: IFM Investors divests 14.84% minority stake in Arqiva to Polus Capital Management
records.description: Funds managed by IFM Investors agreed to divest their 14.84% minority stake in Arqiva, the UK's leading broadcast and telecommunications infrastructure operator, to Polus Capital Management for GBP 8.9mm. The sale follows Polus's earlier acquisition of Macquarie Asset Management's 26.54% stake, bringing Polus's combined equity interest in Arqiva to 41.38%. Arqiva's revenue base is underpinned by long-term, RPI-linked contracts with investment-grade counterparties including the BBC and major mobile network operators.

records.title: Goldman Sachs Alternatives commits $169mm preferred equity in Nighthawk BESS project
records.description: Goldman Sachs Alternatives committed a $169mm preferred equity investment in Arevon Energy's 300 MW / 1,200 MWh Nighthawk Energy Storage Project in Poway, California, as part of a broader $920mm financing package. The total financing comprises a $482mm debt facility led by CIBC, the Goldman Sachs preferred equity tranche structured to simplify tax credit monetization, and a $268mm tax credit transfer commitment. The lithium iron phosphate battery facility will provide resource adequacy capacity to PG&E under a long-term contract and is expected to become operational later in 2026.

records.title: EQT Infrastructure acquires Steel River solar and storage project via Cypress Creek Renewables
records.target: Steel River Solar and Storage Project
records.description: Cypress Creek Renewables, a portfolio company of EQT Infrastructure, acquired the Steel River solar and storage project in Northeast Arkansas from Swift Current Energy (backed by IFM Investors). The facility combines 2,450 MWdc (1,500 MWac) of solar generation with 2,900 MWh (720 MW) of battery storage across three equal phases, making it one of the largest solar and energy storage projects in the United States. The project is expected to be placed in service in 2029.

records.title: 3i Infrastructure acquires majority stake in Lefdal Mine Datacenter
records.description: 3i Infrastructure agreed to invest approximately €300mm to acquire a majority stake in Lefdal Mine Datacenter, a Norwegian data center campus located in a former mine with 37 MW of operational capacity and 43 MW under construction. The site leverages Norway's low-cost, reliable power supply and a closed-loop seawater cooling system for high energy efficiency, with significant expansion potential across five undeveloped mine levels. The total investment, including growth capital, is expected to reach approximately €400mm.

records.title: ArcLight Capital acquires InfraBridge's 50% stake in IATP thermal power platform
records.description: ArcLight Capital Partners signed a definitive agreement to acquire InfraBridge's (DigitalBridge) 50% stake in Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power, a diversified portfolio of 11 power infrastructure assets totaling approximately 5.4 GW of generation capacity across seven North American markets. Invenergy will retain its existing ownership interest and continue managing operations of the portfolio, which includes highly efficient combined-cycle facilities such as Grays Harbor (WA), Nelson (IL), Lackawanna (PA), and St. Clair (ON).

records.title: Ridgewood Infrastructure acquires controlling interest in Sierra Railroad Company
records.description: Ridgewood Infrastructure acquired a controlling interest in Sierra Railroad Company, a California-based shortline rail platform providing freight rail, switching, storage, and transloading services across approximately 130 miles of track. Founded in 1897, Sierra's network is strategically positioned near major agricultural and dairy production regions, key West Coast ports, and major industrial centers, with interconnections to both Union Pacific and BNSF Class I networks. The platform also includes Railpower, Inc., which owns the only FRA-approved hydrogen-powered locomotive in the U.S.

records.title: Ridgewood Infrastructure acquires CVAT via Sierra Railroad bolt-on
records.description: Simultaneously with Ridgewood's acquisition of Sierra Railroad, Sierra acquired Central Valley Ag Transport, an agricultural products transload facility owner and operator serving customers along Sierra's rail network. The bolt-on vertically integrates agricultural transload capabilities essential to California's dairy and broader agricultural industry, enabling efficient movement of feed and agricultural products while deepening customer relationships and increasing rail utilization.

records.title: Diverso Energy / CVC DIF partner with Dandelion Energy on geothermal heat pump platform
records.buyer: Diverso Energy / CVC DIF / Dandelion Energy
records.description: Diverso Energy, backed by CVC DIF, announced a strategic partnership with Dandelion Energy to accelerate geothermal heat pump deployment across U.S. housing markets.

records.title: Stonepeak / Alphabet combine GFiber with Astound Broadband
records.description: Stonepeak and Alphabet announced the combination of GFiber with Stonepeak's Astound Broadband, creating a leading independent broadband provider.

records.title: EQT Infrastructure and GIC acquire 42% of Kelda Holdings (Yorkshire Water) from DWS and Corsair
records.description: EQT Active Core Infrastructure agreed to acquire a 42% shareholding in Kelda Holdings, the parent company of Yorkshire Water, which provides essential water and wastewater services to approximately 5.5 million customers across over two million homes and 140,000 businesses in the UK. The transaction sees DWS Infrastructure and Corsair Capital exit their minority positions while GIC increases its stake to 42% and TCorp to 16%, positioning the new shareholder group to support a GBP 8.3bn investment program between 2025 and 2030. EQT has also committed to contributing further equity to strengthen the balance sheet.

records.title: Siris acquires majority stake in TAKKION from Apollo
records.description: Siris agreed to acquire a majority stake in TAKKION from funds managed by Apollo Global Management. TAKKION, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, is the premier integrated logistics, O&M, and technical services provider to the renewable energy industry, comprising Transportation Partners & Logistics, Global Specialized Services, RENEW Energy, and Airway Services (approximately $600mm revenue in 2025). Siris plans to expand TAKKION's service offerings across wind, solar, battery, and transmission sectors.

records.title: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners acquires majority stake in Advanced Cooling Technologies
records.description: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners agreed to acquire a majority stake in Advanced Cooling Technologies, a Pennsylvania-based manufacturer of highly-engineered thermal management and energy efficiency solutions serving data center, defense, space, and energy applications. ACT's product suite, including two-phase liquid cooling, heat pipes, and cold plates, is well-positioned to benefit from rising power density and cooling requirements driven by AI infrastructure buildout. ACT's executive team will remain in place and continue as significant shareholders.

records.title: EIG acquires JERA's interests in Gorgon LNG and Ichthys LNG via MidOcean Energy
records.description: MidOcean Energy, a globally diversified LNG platform formed and managed by EIG Global Energy Partners, entered into definitive agreements to acquire JERA's 0.417% interest in the Chevron-operated 15.6 mtpa Gorgon LNG project, increasing MidOcean's stake to 1.417%. The transaction perimeter also includes JERA's 0.735% interest in the Inpex-operated 8.9 mtpa Ichthys LNG project, which will be transferred to an existing Ichthys JV participant upon closing.

records.title: Standard Solar / Brookfield acquire 48.4 MW New Mexico community solar portfolio
records.description: Standard Solar, a Brookfield portfolio company, acquired a 48.4 MW community solar portfolio in New Mexico from Pluma Construction and ForeFront Power.

records.title: KKR invests in PMI Electro / Allfleet
records.description: KKR agreed to invest up to $310mm for a majority stake in Allfleet and a minority stake in PMI Electro Mobility, scaling the e-bus platform across India.

records.title: Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners divests Bayonne Energy Center to Jupiter Energy Investor
records.description: Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners agreed to sell its stake in Thermal Bayonne Holdings, operator of the 660 MW Bayonne Energy Center, to Jupiter Energy Investor.

records.title: Equitix / COFIDES co-invest in Spanish Hybridisation Platform
records.description: COFIDES committed up to €150mm to join Equitix's renewable hybridisation platform in Spain, co-investing alongside an Australian institutional investor.

records.title: Cube Highways Trust / I Squared Capital acquire four highway assets from sponsor
records.buyer: Cube Highways Trust / I Squared Capital
records.description: Cube Highways Trust executed a binding commitment to acquire four highway entities from its sponsor via an equity swap arrangement.

records.title: Ares Management invests in Plenitude via capital increase
records.description: Eni announced a ~€1.5bn capital increase for Plenitude, with at least €1bn from Ares Management, as part of a shareholding reorganization to deconsolidate the renewables and retail energy platform.

records.title: CBRE Investment Management acquires 10% stake in Porterbrook
records.description: CBRE Investment Management's Private Infrastructure division agreed to acquire a 10% stake in Porterbrook, one of the UK's three major rolling stock companies.

records.title: Zenobe / KKR acquire Revolv
records.description: Zenobe, backed by KKR, Infracapital, and Mubadala, acquired California-based Revolv to expand its North American electric vehicle fleet operations.

records.title: APG Asset Management co-invests in NorthC Datacenters alongside Antin
records.buyer: APG Asset Management / Antin Infrastructure Partners
records.description: APG Asset Management co-invested in NorthC Datacenters alongside Antin Infrastructure Partners' platform buyout from DWS.

records.title: Axium Infrastructure Europe acquires 49.9% stake in 174 MW French wind portfolio
records.description: Axium Infrastructure Europe acquired a 49.9% interest in a 174 MW operating wind portfolio in France from la Banque des Territoires.

records.title: ReNew Energy Global divests Tamil Nadu Solar Project to Technique Solaire / ADIA Infrastructure
records.description: ReNew Energy Global agreed to sell its 100 MW Tamil Nadu solar project to Technique Solaire, backed by ADIA Infrastructure.

records.title: Generate Capital divests Equinox Growers greenhouse facility to Taylor Farms
records.description: Generate Capital announced the sale of its Equinox Growers greenhouse facility to Taylor Farms.

records.title: Igneo Infrastructure Partners acquires OnStream
records.description: Igneo Infrastructure Partners entered a binding agreement to acquire OnStream, a UK smart meter asset provider.

records.title: Brookfield / La Caisse acquire Boralex
records.description: Brookfield and La Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec agreed to acquire Boralex Inc. for C$37.25 per share in an all-cash take-private transaction.

records.title: KWAP joins Stonepeak / KJTS in Lestari Cooling Energy
records.description: KJTS and Stonepeak added KWAP as an investor in Lestari Cooling Energy Sdn. Bhd., strengthening the Malaysian district cooling platform.

records.title: Allianz Global Investors acquires stake in Amprion from Talanx
records.description: Allianz Global Investors agreed to acquire an indirect stake in Amprion, a German electricity transmission grid operator, from Talanx.

records.title: Sonnedix / J.P. Morgan Asset Management acquire Akira solar portfolio
records.target: Akira Portfolio (6 Italian Solar PV Plants)
records.description: Sonnedix acquired the 194 MW Akira portfolio of six Italian solar PV plants from EOS Investment Management and Capital Dynamics, surpassing 1 GW of operating capacity in Italy.

records.title: VINCI Highways acquires Safeway Concessions from Macquarie Asset Management
records.description: VINCI Highways agreed to acquire Safeway Concessions, comprising nine Indian toll highway concessions, from Macquarie Asia Infrastructure Fund 2.

records.title: Abertis acquires remaining stake in A63 Motorway from HICL / CVC DIF / NGE Autoroutes
records.seller: HICL Infrastructure / CVC DIF / NGE Autoroutes
records.description: Abertis acquired the remaining 49% of the A63 motorway in France from HICL Infrastructure, CVC DIF, and NGE Autoroutes, taking full ownership of the 104 km concession.

records.title: H.I.G. Capital divests Desktop S.A. to Claro
records.description: H.I.G. Capital signed a definitive agreement to sell Desktop S.A., a Brazilian fiber broadband provider, to Claro.

records.title: Goldman Sachs-backed LES acquires All American Grease Services
records.description: LES acquired All American Grease Services Companies, a non-hazardous liquid waste company offering grease trap and used cooking oil collection services across the Gulf Coast and Southeast US. The acquisition added five service branches and three wastewater treatment facilities to LES’s network of 300+ vacuum trucks and 24 treatment plants.

records.title: Igneo acquires Mattingly Cold Storage to form ChillCo Logistics
records.description: Igneo agreed to acquire Mattingly Cold Storage, a 275k sq. ft. multi-temperature, post-production focused cold storage business in Zanesville, Ohio, as the foundation of ChillCo Logistics. The deal marks Igneo’s inaugural U.S. cold-storage investment and extends its transportation and logistics exposure.

records.title: Equitix / John Laing acquire remaining 50% stake in I-4 Ultimate Project from Skanska
records.target: I-4 Ultimate Project (50% stake from Skanska)
records.description: John Laing Investments Limited, jointly owned by Equitix and John Laing, reached financial close on the acquisition of Skanska’s 50% stake in I-4 Ultimate, securing full ownership of the asset. The project covers approximately 21 miles of Interstate 4 in central Florida and serves more than 200,000 motorists daily under a 40-year availability-based P3 concession.

records.title: HICL acquires incremental stake in Cross London Trains
records.description: HICL agreed to acquire a further 6.65% interest in Cross London Trains for approximately £52mm, taking its total economic interest to 13.13%. XLT owns the fleet of 115 Siemens Class 700 electric trains operating on Thameslink, one of the UK’s most important transport corridors linking St Pancras, Gatwick Airport and Luton Airport.

records.title: I Squared-backed CubeCold acquires 24H Frost
records.description: CubeCold entered the French market through the acquisition of 24H Frost, adding a fully automated cold-storage facility in the port of Loon-Plage, Dunkirk. The site offers more than 12,000 frozen pallet positions, and the acquisition expands CubeCold’s network to over 700,000 pallet spaces across six European markets.

records.title: Equitix acquires UK social infrastructure PPP portfolio from Sir Robert McAlpine
records.description: Equitix completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity and subordinated debt interests in a UK social infrastructure PPP portfolio from Sir Robert McAlpine Capital Ventures for Equitix Fund VII. The assets include Gateshead Schools PPP, Redcar Primary Care Hospital PPP and an additional 50% interest in City of Glasgow College PPP, serving more than 6,500 students and providing more than 30 community hospital beds.

records.title: Tiger Infrastructure Partners invests in Orbis Protect
records.description: Tiger agreed a transformational growth capital investment in Orbis Protect, a UK-based owner and operator of dynamic security solutions. The capital is intended to fund further technology investment, expansion across the UK and Europe, and continued international growth, while facilitating Synova’s exit.

records.title: Harrison Street / Stonemont acquire Northside East Cobb Medical Center
records.description: Harrison Street partnered with Stonemont on the acquisition of Northside East Cobb Medical Center, a 103,184 sq. ft., 100%-leased medical office building in Marietta, Georgia. Anchored by Northside Hospital, the four-story facility houses imaging, orthopedics, primary care, urgent care, and physician specialty services.

records.title: InfraVia creates Supernova Power through Mercia Power Response and Balance Power merger
records.target: Mercia Power Response + Balance Power Projects
records.description: InfraVia acquired majority stakes in Mercia Power Response and Balance Power and will merge the two businesses into Supernova Power, a UK-focused flexible power platform. Mercia operates 262MW of gas peaking and battery storage assets with more than 400MW in development, while Balance adds a battery storage pipeline of over 1.4GW.

records.title: Ancala-backed Croatian Biomass Platform acquires three biomass plants
records.description: Ancala’s Croatian Biomass Platform acquired three 5MW biomass plants from The Sherif Group, more than doubling renewable generation capacity to 25MW. The five-site platform now generates approximately 200,000 MWh annually, equivalent to powering more than 45,000 homes, with the newly acquired plants backed by long-term feed-in tariffs and biomass supply agreements.

records.title: Carlyle participates in Nxtra Data funding round
records.description: Carlyle participated in Airtel’s US$1.0bn funding round for Nxtra, which values the data-center platform at around US$3.1bn post-closing. Carlyle is committing US$240mm, and Nxtra plans to deploy the capital to expand its network across India, scaling from roughly 300MW today toward 1GW over time.

records.title: DigitalBridge and JEXI acquire selected NEC data center assets
records.target: Selected Data Center Assets from NEC Corporation
records.description: DigitalBridge and JEXI completed the acquisition of selected NEC data-center assets in the Greater Tokyo and Kansai regions. The assets will operate as a new standalone platform, with NEC retained as anchor customer under contract as the business seeks to add third-party colocation demand.

records.title: Antin acquires Sapphire Gas Solutions from Apollo
records.description: Antin, through Flagship Fund V, acquired Sapphire Gas Solutions from Apollo-managed funds. Sapphire owns and operates infrastructure to compress, liquefy, transport and store CNG and LNG, operates across 30 U.S. states, and serves more than 120 customers.

records.title: Blackstone acquires 49% stake in Rowan Digital Infrastructure from Quinbrook
records.description: Quinbrook announced a strategic recapitalization of Rowan Digital Infrastructure through the sale of a 49% significant minority stake to funds affiliated with Blackstone. The transaction monetizes part of Quinbrook’s ownership while retaining control, partnering with Blackstone to support Rowan’s next phase of growth and continued hyperscale data center expansion serving cloud and AI-driven demand.

records.title: DataBank and Goodman form 32 MW Los Angeles data center joint venture
records.target: DataBank / Goodman Los Angeles JV (32 MW)
records.buyer: Swiss Life Asset Managers / IMCO / AustralianSuper / DataBank / Goodman
records.description: DataBank and Goodman formed a 50/50 joint venture to develop a 32 MW AI-ready data center in Vernon, California. The arrangement advances sponsor-backed digital infrastructure development in a supply-constrained Los Angeles market and adds to DataBank’s broader U.S. expansion pipeline.

records.title: DWS-backed Stellanor acquires Hemel Hempstead data center
records.description: DWS, through portfolio company Stellanor, acquired a purpose-built data center in Hemel Hempstead from Imagination Technologies in a sale-and-service-back structure. The add-on expands Stellanor’s UK footprint while keeping the seller as a continuing service customer at the site.

records.title: Energy Capital Partners agrees to acquire EnergySolutions
records.description: ECP agreed to acquire EnergySolutions in a full platform buyout, returning the nuclear services provider to infrastructure ownership. The deal adds exposure to essential decommissioning, waste management, and broader nuclear lifecycle services as electricity demand and energy security priorities continue to reshape the sector.

records.title: Equitix acquires majority stake in Canales Sur wind project
records.description: Equitix acquired a majority equity stake in the 120 MW Canales Sur onshore wind project in Spain, extending its partnership with Capital Energy. The deal adds another renewables asset to Equitix’s Iberian hybridisation strategy, with future solar and storage expansion expected alongside the wind platform.

records.title: Ara Partners commits growth capital to Sedron Technologies
records.description: Ara committed up to $500mm to Sedron Technologies to scale infrastructure that converts wastewater and organic waste streams into reusable resources and clean electricity. The investment reflects continuing sponsor interest in circular infrastructure platforms with both environmental services and energy outputs.

records.title: EQT sells minority stake in Nordic Ferry Infrastructure
records.description: EQT agreed to sell a 30% minority stake in Nordic Ferry Infrastructure to a consortium of long-term investors while retaining a 70% majority interest. The transaction broadens the platform’s investor base following its transformation into a pan-Nordic maritime transportation infrastructure business.

records.title: CIP divests Summerfield Battery Energy Storage Project to Palisade
records.target: Summerfield Battery Energy Storage Project (240 MW / 960 MWh)
records.description: CIP divested its 100% equity stake in the Summerfield Battery Energy Storage Project to Palisade Investment Partners. The asset is a utility-scale 240 MW / 960 MWh lithium-ion battery system located in South Australia.

records.title: Patrizia divests Sustainable Energy Infrastructure to CleanPeak Energy
records.description: Patrizia signed a binding agreement to fully divest its 100% equity stake in Sustainable Energy Infrastructure (SEI) to CleanPeak Energy. SEI owns, develops and operates a distributed portfolio of sub-5 MW solar arrays and battery energy storage systems.

records.title: Antin-backed Consilium acquires Insplorion hydrogen sensor business
records.buyer: Antin Infrastructure Partners (via Consilium Safety Group)
records.description: Consilium Safety Group, a portfolio company of Antin Infrastructure Partners, acquired Insplorion’s hydrogen sensor technology business, including related intellectual property and physical assets for advanced hydrogen detection sensors.

records.title: TPG invests $100mm in Züm
records.description: TPG made a $100mm strategic growth equity investment into Züm, an operator of electric school bus fleets and mass student mobility networks, valuing the specialized transportation infrastructure company at $1.7bn.

records.title: CBRE-backed Canadian Resource Roadways acquires Berland and Home Creek roads
records.target: Berland Resource Road & Home Creek Road
records.buyer: CBRE Investment Management (via Canadian Resource Roadways)
records.description: Canadian Resource Roadways, a portfolio company of CBRE Investment Management, signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 90% equity stake in a 134-kilometer industrial access road network that supports regional forestry and energy operations.

records.title: I Squared Capital acquires Spire natural gas storage assets
records.description: I Squared Capital agreed to acquire the midstream natural gas storage assets of Spire Inc. for $650mm in cash and deferred payments. The assets provide up to 72 Bcf of combined working gas capacity.

records.title: Macquarie agrees to divest Evryo Group to Premier Energy
records.description: Macquarie Asset Management agreed to divest its 100% equity interest in Evryo Group to Premier Energy Group. Evryo operates a regulated electricity distribution network in Romania spanning 80,000 kilometers and connecting 1.5mm customers.

records.title: Allianz Global Investors acquires majority stake in GESI
records.description: Allianz Global Investors acquired a 51% stake in GESI on behalf of Allianz insurance companies, marking the firm’s second direct equity investment in German battery storage following its March partnership with TotalEnergies. GESI develops, builds and operates large utility-scale battery storage and is currently advancing three projects across Bavaria and Lower Saxony with an aggregate grid connection capacity of approximately 2.6 GW.

records.title: CPP Investments-backed Cordelio sells 6 GW JV interest to BrightNight
records.description: BrightNight bought out JV partner Cordelio Power’s interest in 6 GW of US solar and storage development projects, taking full ownership and control of the assets and leaving four operating/construction-stage projects within the legacy JV. The transaction follows BrightNight’s recent $850mm corporate credit facility close and reinforces the AI-focused IPP’s western US footprint; Cordelio is the renewables platform owned by CPP Investments.

records.title: Partners Group-backed PowerTransitions acquires Alliance Energy Group portfolio
records.description: PowerTransitions agreed to acquire a five-plant, 323 MW portfolio — comprising the Batavia, Hillburn, Massena, Shoemaker and Sterling assets — along with associated pipeline infrastructure from Alliance Energy Group, marking the Partners Group-backed platform’s entry into the New York market. The transaction will lift PowerTransitions’ total operating fleet to roughly 550 MW across seven stations supplying multiple NYISO zones.

records.title: Quinbrook-backed Elemental acquires Los Angeles renewable hydrogen project from FPH2
records.target: FPH2’s Los Angeles County Renewable Hydrogen Project
records.description: Elemental Clean Fuels will acquire one of FPH2’s priority renewable hydrogen projects in Los Angeles County and lead its development, financing and construction as part of its growing North American clean fuels platform. The solar-powered electrolytic facility is designed to supply zero-emission hydrogen to data centers, microgrids, hydrogen-capable turbines, transit fleets and port operations; Elemental is backed by Quinbrook following a strategic transaction closed in late 2025.

records.title: KKR invests $1.5bn in Vertical Bridge alongside DigitalBridge and La Caisse
records.description: KKR is making a $1.5bn strategic equity investment in Vertical Bridge, joining existing sponsors DigitalBridge and La Caisse (formerly CDPQ), who both rolled into the new structure to establish a fully funded, long-term capital base. Vertical Bridge is the largest private owner and operator of communications infrastructure in the United States, with a portfolio of more than 17,000 towers; KKR has now deployed over $40bn of equity into digital infrastructure globally.

records.title: EQT seeds AI Infrastructure strategy with EdgeConneX
records.description: EQT launched a dedicated AI Infrastructure strategy fully seeded by portfolio company EdgeConneX, transferring the data center platform from EQT Infrastructure into the new vehicle to support its growth trajectory. Since EQT’s 2020 acquisition, EdgeConneX has scaled capacity nearly 20x and plans to develop more than 10 GW of additional data center capacity, leveraging EQT’s broader infrastructure platform of 100+ GW energy pipeline, 90+ data centers and 29mm miles of fiber.

records.title: Charlesbank invests in Spectrotel and combines platform with AireSpring
records.description: Charlesbank will make a new strategic investment in Grain Management portfolio company Spectrotel, with Grain reinvesting alongside, and concurrently combine the company with AireSpring to form a leading managed network services platform. The Lonstein family, AireSpring’s founders, will remain significant minority investors; together the two businesses combine Spectrotel’s distributed enterprise reach with AireSpring’s global connectivity and managed services capabilities.

records.title: Patrizia takes over SiFi Networks America
records.description: Patrizia’s Smart City Infrastructure Fund — a partnership with Dutch pension investor APG — took over SiFi Networks America from co-founder Mike Harris’s Ubuntu Business Holdings, consolidating the FiberCity platform under its existing infrastructure backers. SiFi designs, builds and operates open-access municipal fiber networks across the US under its FiberCity model, with active deployments spanning California, Wisconsin and other markets.

records.title: Apollo acquires KKR stake in Pembina Gas Infrastructure
records.description: Apollo-managed funds agreed to acquire KKR’s 40% interest in Pembina Gas Infrastructure, with Pembina Pipeline retaining its 60% stake and existing governance unchanged; the deal is expected to close by the end of Q2 2026. PGI — formed as a JV between Pembina and KKR in 2022 — operates roughly 5 Bcf/d of processing capacity across 23 plants, ~3,900 km of gathering pipelines and ~330,000 bpd of NGL extraction serving Montney and Duvernay producers in Alberta and British Columbia.

records.title: GIC divests Teréga stake to Enagás
records.description: Spanish gas TSO Enagás agreed to acquire GIC’s 31.5% stake in French operator Teréga for €573mm, with closing expected during 2026 subject to French and Spanish regulatory approvals. Teréga operates approximately 5,100 km of gas transmission pipelines and two underground storage facilities in southwestern France, representing roughly 16% of the national transmission network and 27% of French storage capacity.

records.title: Stonepeak recapitalizes Southern Marinas
records.description: Stonepeak recapitalized Southern Marinas via a buyout of affiliates of KSL Capital Partners, with the transaction closing simultaneously with announcement; PJT Partners and Lazard advised the buy-side and sell-side respectively. Founded in 2018, Southern Marinas owns and operates 16 marinas across eight US states with more than 6,700 slips, complemented by fuel, boat rentals and service operations.

records.title: Stonepeak-backed Southern Marinas acquires F3 Marina Fort Lauderdale
records.description: Southern Marinas acquired F3 Marina Fort Lauderdale on the same day as its Stonepeak recapitalization, adding the 59,000-square-foot facility to its portfolio in a deal facilitated by Colliers. Billed as the world’s tallest dry stack marina at 130 feet, F3 houses 254 vessels across six tiers and operates a first-of-its-kind automated overhead crane system that retrieves boats up to 47 feet in under five minutes — with roughly 90% of revenue derived from storage.

records.title: Sixth Street forms affordable housing partnership with HSPG and PPHA
records.description: Sixth Street will provide the majority of equity capital for a new strategic partnership with HSPG and PPHA, with HSPG continuing to lead asset management and platform strategy; the venture targets more than £1bn of investment in UK affordable housing delivery. PPHA is one of the UK’s largest For-Profit Registered Providers, with a contracted pipeline of c.1,100 homes and 4,000+ additional units identified across Affordable Rent, Social Rent, Shared Ownership and Grant-Led tenures.

records.title: Bernhard-backed Delta Utilities acquires Spire Mississippi
records.description: Bernhard-backed Delta Utilities agreed to acquire Spire’s Mississippi local distribution company for $75mm in cash — representing a 1.4x multiple of 2025 rate base — with closing targeted for fiscal Q1 2027 subject to Mississippi PSC approval. Spire Mississippi operates approximately 745 miles of distribution pipelines serving roughly 18,000 customers in south-central Mississippi including Hattiesburg; Spire will redeploy proceeds into infrastructure investments across its Alabama, Missouri and Tennessee gas utilities.

records.title: GIP combines Saavi Energía with Grupo México power assets
records.target: Saavi Energía & Grupo México Power Assets
records.description: Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock, entered into a definitive agreement to combine its Saavi Energía portfolio company with Grupo México’s power generation assets. The resulting platform will have 4,510 MW of combined output and an approximately 5,000 MW project pipeline, with Grupo México owning 70% and GIP retaining a 30% minority stake.

records.title: Blackstone invests up to €2bn in Eurowind Energy
records.description: Funds managed by Blackstone Infrastructure entered into a definitive agreement to invest up to €2bn in Eurowind Energy, a pan-European renewables developer and independent power producer. The perpetual capital will support Eurowind’s onshore wind, solar, battery storage, and biogas development activity across 16 European markets.

records.title: Brookfield Renewable sells remaining interest in non-core U.S. hydro assets
records.description: Brookfield Renewable agreed to sell its remaining 50% interest in a portfolio of non-core U.S. hydroelectric assets, fully monetizing the investment after last year’s initial 50% stake sale at the same valuation. Total proceeds upon closing are expected to be approximately $1bn, including roughly $500mm net to Brookfield Renewable.

records.title: IFM Investors acquires remaining stake in Nala Renewables from Trafigura
records.description: Funds managed by IFM Investors agreed to acquire the remaining 50% equity stake in London-based Nala Renewables from Trafigura, bringing IFM to full ownership. Nala manages a multi-technology portfolio of more than 2 GW across solar PV, onshore wind, and battery energy storage systems in strategic European markets.

records.title: CIP acquires Ørsted European onshore business and launches Perigus Energy
records.description: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners completed its acquisition of Ørsted’s European onshore business through CI V and launched the platform as Perigus Energy. The company operates across Ireland, Germany, the UK, and Spain with 826 MW of installed and under-construction capacity and a multi-GW pipeline spanning wind, solar, and battery storage.

records.title: I Squared acquires Oriden from Mitsubishi Power Americas
records.description: I Squared’s Energy Transition Fund acquired Oriden, a Pittsburgh-based renewable energy developer, from Mitsubishi Power Americas. Oriden has a 5+ GW solar PV and battery storage pipeline concentrated in MISO and PJM, and I Squared plans to invest approximately $300mm to scale the platform into a next-generation IPP.

records.title: Generate and Monarch form 104 MW community solar joint investment portfolio
records.description: Generate Capital and Monarch Private Capital closed a joint equity investment in a 104 MW community solar portfolio spanning more than 15 projects. The projects are expected to commence operations in the second and third quarters of 2026 and generate approximately $200mm of investment tax credits while expanding local clean power supply.

records.title: Stonepeak and Bernhard agree to acquire Cleco Group
records.seller: Macquarie Asset Management / BCI / Manulife Investment Management
records.description: Stonepeak and Bernhard Capital Partners agreed to acquire Cleco Group from a consortium comprising Macquarie Asset Management, BCI, and Manulife Investment Management. Cleco is a regulated electric utility serving approximately 298,000 customers in Louisiana, with eight generating units totaling 2,676 MW of capacity.

records.title: KKR sells Axius Water to CRH
records.description: CRH agreed to acquire U.S.-based water treatment platform Axius Water from KKR for $700mm. KKR’s Global Impact Fund originally co-established the platform, which provides water quality and nutrient removal infrastructure, and the sale advances CRH’s expansion as a North American water infrastructure provider.

records.title: Argo Infrastructure Partners acquires UGI Pennsylvania electric utility
records.description: Argo Infrastructure Partners reached a definitive agreement to acquire UGI Utilities’ Electric Division for approximately $470mm. The regulated electric utility operates roughly 2,700 miles of transmission and distribution lines and 14 substations in Pennsylvania’s Luzerne and Wyoming counties, representing Argo’s fourth utility investment in the state.

records.title: GIC expands Brazilian transmission partnership with Neoenergia
records.description: GIC and Neoenergia expanded their Brazilian transmission partnership through a R$2.4bn transaction involving a 49% stake in seven transmission assets. The agreement strengthens the platform’s regulated transmission footprint, which is expected to include 16 assets totaling approximately 6,710 km of lines after completion.

records.title: I Squared agrees to acquire Elea Data Centers
records.description: I Squared agreed to acquire Elea Data Centers, one of Brazil’s largest carrier-neutral data center platforms. Elea operates nine interconnected campuses across key Brazilian markets with more than 300 MW of powered land and over 1 GW in development, requiring more than US$10bn of capital to fully deliver.

records.title: Wren House and T-Mobile form joint venture to acquire i3 Broadband
records.description: T-Mobile entered into a definitive agreement to form a 50/50 joint venture with Wren House to acquire i3 Broadband, with T-Mobile expected to invest approximately $700mm for its 50% equity interest. i3 Broadband is a fiber-to-the-premises operator serving customers across Illinois, Missouri, and Rhode Island.

records.title: Ares acquires Rover Pipeline stake from Blackstone
records.description: Ares Infrastructure Opportunities acquired a 32.4% minority equity stake in the Rover Pipeline from funds managed by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners. The 700-mile transmission pipeline provides 3.425 Bcf/d of Appalachian Basin takeaway capacity to Midwest demand centers and remains substantially contracted under long-term agreements.

records.title: Brookfield Infrastructure agrees to sell Inter Terminals
records.description: Brookfield Infrastructure disclosed a signed definitive agreement to sell its Scandinavian bulk liquid storage business, Inter Terminals. The Nordic platform operates terminal locations across Denmark and Sweden with access to transport links and transhipment services, continuing Brookfield’s capital recycling program.

records.title: Arcus Infrastructure Partners agrees to acquire majority stake in TrueNoord
records.description: Arcus Infrastructure Partners entered into definitive documentation to acquire an approximately 74% majority stake in specialist regional aircraft lessor TrueNoord. The transaction facilitates an exit for previous investors including Patria, while founding investor Freshstream will reinvest alongside Arcus to support future fleet growth.

records.title: IFM Investors agrees to acquire Briggs Equipment UK
records.description: IFM Investors agreed to acquire 100% of Briggs Equipment UK from Sammons Enterprises. Briggs is one of the largest independent materials handling platforms in the UK and Ireland, with more than 40 depots, over 850 engineers, and a managed fleet of approximately 53,000 assets serving infrastructure and industrial customers.

records.title: Stonepeak to acquire BMO Transportation and Vendor Finance
records.description: Stonepeak reached an agreement to acquire BMO's Transportation Finance and Vendor Finance businesses, including related loan portfolios in the United States and Canada. BMO will reinvest for a 19.9% minority interest, while the platform continues to provide financing for trucks, trailers and other transportation and vendor equipment.

records.title: Meridiam launches Siruai Wind and Storage project in Kenya
records.description: Meridiam and Craftskills Energy launched the Siruai Wind and Storage project in Kenya, combining 100 MW of wind generation with a 50 MWh battery energy storage system. The project is located near the Kipeto wind farm in Kajiado County and is backed by more than EUR200mm of investment.

records.title: Basalt Infrastructure Partners agrees to acquire R.E.L.A.M.
records.description: Funds advised by Basalt Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire R.E.L.A.M., a North American lessor of maintenance-of-way and hi-rail equipment, from Paceline Equity Partners. The company operates a scaled fleet of specialized rail maintenance assets serving railroads, contractors and other rail infrastructure operators.

records.title: Igneo-backed Infinity Aviation Group acquires Corporate Air
records.buyer: Igneo Infrastructure Partners (via Infinity Aviation Group)
records.description: Infinity Aviation Group acquired Corporate Air at Vero Beach Regional Airport in Florida, expanding its fixed-base-operator network into South Florida. The facility includes eight hangars, a large ramp area, a passenger terminal and on-site customs clearance.

records.title: Infratil-backed Kao Data acquires Park Royal data center development site
records.description: Kao Data acquired a 4.7-acre brownfield site on the former Frogmore Industrial Estate in Park Royal, West London, from ReAssure Limited for a planned data center development. The facility is expected to support AI and advanced computing workloads and go live in 2029, subject to planning.

records.title: Equitix-backed Aurora Infrastructure to acquire Terrafame grid assets
records.description: Aurora Infrastructure entered into a strategic partnership with Terrafame by acquiring the high- and medium-voltage electrical grid assets at Terrafame's Sotkamo industrial site in Finland. The transaction is structured as a buy-and-lease-back arrangement supporting industrial-site power infrastructure.

records.title: Apollo funds acquire majority stake in Noble Environmental
records.description: Apollo-managed funds acquired a majority interest in Noble Environmental, a vertically integrated waste-management platform headquartered in Pittsburgh. Noble provides waste collection, hauling, transfer and disposal services and operates renewable natural gas facilities at landfill gas locations.

records.title: Mubadala invests in Hornsea 3 alongside Apollo-led consortium
records.description: Mubadala announced a US$325mm investment in Ørsted's Hornsea 3 offshore wind farm alongside a consortium led by Apollo-managed funds. Hornsea 3 is expected to deliver 2.9 GW of capacity off the Norfolk coast in the United Kingdom, with Ørsted retaining 50% ownership and leading development, construction and operation.

records.title: GIP-managed fund agrees to sell 187 MW Taiwan solar portfolio to J&V Energy
records.description: J&V Energy agreed to acquire a 187 MW operational solar portfolio in Taiwan from a fund managed by Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock. The operating portfolio expands J&V Energy's renewable power platform in Taiwan.

records.title: TPG-backed Kinetic agrees to acquire Dysons
records.description: Kinetic entered into an agreement to acquire 100% of Dysons, an Australian bus and coach operator serving Victoria and New South Wales. The transaction expands Kinetic's bus network and zero-emissions transport strategy and is expected to complete in the second half of 2026 subject to approvals.

records.title: Goldman Sachs Alternatives acquires QScale
records.description: Infrastructure at Goldman Sachs Alternatives closed the acquisition of QScale, a Canadian developer and operator of next-generation, AI-ready data centers. QScale's founders and management are reinvesting alongside Goldman Sachs Alternatives and will continue to lead the business.

records.title: La Caisse and GEB establish Verene power transmission platform in Brazil
records.description: La Caisse and Grupo Energía Bogotá entered into a final agreement to create a jointly controlled 50/50 power transmission platform in Brazil under the Verene Energia S.A. name. The combined platform will include 26 electric transmission concessions and more than 9,000 km of transmission lines across 17 Brazilian states.

records.title: Mubadala, CPP and Ares back Caturus Commonwealth LNG FID
records.buyer: Mubadala / CPP Investments / Ares Management / Kimmeridge Energy
records.description: Caturus made a positive final investment decision for the Commonwealth LNG project in Louisiana, including the successful closing of $9.75bn in project financing for a 9.5 mtpa LNG export facility. Mubadala Energy is an equity participant, CPP Investments is increasing its stake, and major financial partners include an Ares Infrastructure Opportunities fund.

records.title: H.I.G. Capital completes acquisition of International Aerospace Coatings from Tiger Infrastructure
records.description: H.I.G. Capital completed the acquisition of International Aerospace Coatings from Tiger Infrastructure Partners. IAC provides aircraft painting and aviation technical services from a global footprint of 25 hangars across 11 sites in the United States and Europe.

records.title: Power Factors | Mubadala
records.description: Mubadala announced a significant minority investment in Power Factors alongside existing investor Vista Equity Partners. Power Factors provides a renewable energy management suite for wind, solar, and storage operators, supporting more than 600 customers across 18,000 sites in over 70 countries and managing approximately 310 GW of capacity.

records.title: Air Liquide Biogas Assets | Mobius Renewables / IFM
records.description: Air Liquide agreed to divest its biogas production activities in the United States, France, Norway, and Sweden to Mobius Renewables, the low-carbon fuels platform established by IFM-managed funds. The carve-out includes production units and distribution assets and expands Mobius beyond its initial GreenGasUSA platform.

records.title: Nordergründe Offshore Wind Farm | Skyborn / GIP
records.description: Public merger-control disclosure showed Skyborn Renewables, a Global Infrastructure Partners portfolio company, seeking the indirect acquisition of a 70% stake and sole control of OWP Nordergründe GmbH & Co. KG. Nordergründe is an operating offshore wind project in Germany with 111 MW of capacity.

records.title: 117 MWp Sicily Agrivoltaic Portfolio | Verdian / Nuveen Infrastructure
records.description: Verdian, a clean-energy IPP controlled by Nuveen Infrastructure, acquired a 117 MWp portfolio of three ready-to-build agrivoltaic projects in Sicily from Genertec International Holding. The projects are located in Ramacca and Paternò, have secured FER X contracts under a CfD structure with GSE, and are expected to begin construction toward the end of 2026 with operations targeted between mid- and late-2027.

records.title: BayWa r.e. Power Solutions | Fervo / Energy Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Fervo acquired BayWa r.e. Power Solutions from BayWa r.e. AG, an EIP-linked renewable-energy platform. The Verona-based business develops and builds rooftop and ground-mounted PV systems, storage systems, and integrated energy solutions for industrial customers, utilities, and IPPs, with more than 120 MWp installed and annual revenue exceeding €20mm.

records.title: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities | Mubadala / CBRE IM
records.description: CBRE Investment Management-backed Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities closed a $630mm primary capital raise, bringing total equity commitments to $1.26bn. The round included additional investments from funds managed by CBRE IM and new capital from Mubadala, Australian Retirement Trust, and other global investors to support a site platform across digital, renewable, and transportation infrastructure.

records.title: NEXTDC | CPP Investments
records.description: CPP Investments disclosed a substantial holding in NEXTDC Limited, Australia’s listed data-center operator, representing 36,750,320 ordinary shares and 5.09% voting power. The position follows NEXTDC’s recent equity issuance and capital plan to support accelerated data-center development.

records.title: Americold North American Cold Storage JV | EQT
records.target: Americold North American Cold Storage JV
records.description: Americold and EQT formed a $1.3bn North American cold-storage joint venture backed by EQT’s Active Core Infrastructure fund. Americold will contribute 12 facilities totaling approximately 124mm cubic feet of temperature-controlled capacity and more than 400,000 pallet positions, with EQT acquiring a 70% interest and Americold retaining 30% and day-to-day management.

records.title: Textainer / Seaco | Mubadala / Stonepeak
records.description: Mubadala announced a $300mm co-investment alongside Stonepeak to support Textainer’s acquisition of Seaco. The investment backs the combination of two container leasing businesses and creates one of the world’s largest container leasing platforms, with the combined fleet serving shipping lines across global trade routes.

records.title: bestUV | H2O Innovation / Ember Infrastructure
records.description: H2O Innovation, an Ember Infrastructure portfolio company, acquired bestUV, a Dutch manufacturer of ultraviolet water-disinfection systems. The bolt-on expands H2O Innovation into UV disinfection and adds proprietary reactors serving municipal, industrial, maritime, and other water-treatment applications.

records.title: Casa dos Ventos Renewable-Power Assets | Patria
records.description: Omnia, Patria's data center platform, signed a $2bn, 20-year renewable energy supply agreement with Casa dos Ventos to power its Pecem data center for ByteDance. The self-production structure gives Omnia a stake in wind assets including the 630 MW Ibiapaba complex, tying renewable generation to a large hyperscale development.

records.title: North Star Renewable Energy Platform | CIP
records.description: CIP and British International Investment launched North Star, a $300mm India renewables platform with each party committing up to $150mm. The platform will invest in solar, wind, hybrid renewable and storage projects, addressing development-capital bottlenecks in India's clean-power buildout.

records.title: FirstLight U.S. Clean-Power Portfolio | PSP Investments
records.description: PSP agreed to sell FirstLight's U.S. operations to Hull Street Energy. The portfolio includes about 1.4 GW of hydroelectric generation, energy storage and renewable assets in Massachusetts, Connecticut and Pennsylvania, while PSP retains FirstLight's Canadian platform.

records.title: Birdseye Battery Storage Project | GSAM
records.description: GridStor acquired the 199 MW / 796 MWh Birdseye battery energy storage project in Adams County, Colorado from Accelergen. Backed by GSAM, GridStor expects construction as early as 2027 and commercial operations by the end of 2028.

records.title: 132 MW Saxony Onshore Wind Portfolio | Ardian
records.description: Ardian Clean Energy Evergreen Fund acquired a greenfield onshore wind project portfolio in Saxony totaling 132 MW once constructed. The deal is ACEEF's first German investment and anchors a broader renewables platform in Europe's largest renewable-energy market.

records.title: Barrow Green Hydrogen Project | Schroders Greencoat
records.description: Schroders Greencoat and Carlton Power reached FID through GHECO for the 30 MW Barrow Green Hydrogen Project in Cumbria. The project will use Plug electrolyzers to supply industrial green hydrogen to Kimberly-Clark and is one of the first UK renewable hydrogen projects to reach FID.

records.title: APF Energy | Schroders Greencoat
records.description: Schroders Greencoat acquired 100% of APF Energy from SWEN Capital Partners' impact strategy and APF BV. APF is a Dutch biomethane platform producing renewable gas from agricultural manure and food by-products, with assets positioned for the renewable-molecules market.

records.title: Lind Marine | Tallvine Partners
records.description: Tallvine acquired Lind Marine, expanding its North American marine infrastructure platform to the West Coast following its Donjon Marine acquisition. Lind provides dredging, towing, salvage, shipyard, environmental remediation and harbor and waterway services from its Mare Island base in the San Francisco Bay.

records.title: Equans Infra & Mobility / Velian | DigitalBridge / InfraBridge / Aberdeen
records.description: A DigitalBridge-controlled vehicle and Aberdeen Investments acquired Equans' Dutch asset-based e-mobility activities, which will operate as Velian. The platform designs, finances, builds and operates public and private EV charging infrastructure for government, real estate and logistics customers in the Netherlands.

records.title: Cube Grid | I Squared Capital
records.description: I Squared launched Cube Grid, a power transmission platform in India, with plans to deploy up to $1bn of equity capital. The platform has signed definitive agreements for seed assets totaling more than 1,450 circuit kilometers of transmission lines alongside Dineshchandra Group.

records.title: Kalmar Energi 50% Stake | Igneo
records.description: Nordion Energi, owned by EDIF II and managed by Igneo, signed an agreement to acquire E.ON Sverige's 50% stake in Kalmar Energi. The integrated utility operates across electricity grids, district heating and fiber, with Kalmar Municipality continuing as joint owner.

records.title: Seraya Partners Fund I Interest | GenZero
records.description: GenZero acquired a secondary interest in Seraya Partners Fund I from AIIB, gaining exposure to an Asia-focused infrastructure fund targeting energy transition and digital infrastructure. The portfolio includes Cyan Renewables, a marine energy-transition operator, and Empyrion Digital, a pan-Asia low-carbon data center platform.

records.title: Exolum | OMERS Infrastructure
records.description: OMERS agreed to sell its roughly 25% stake in Exolum, with Stoneshield Capital acquiring 15% and another global investor buying the remaining 10%. Exolum operates refined-products and aviation-fuel logistics infrastructure, including pipeline networks in Spain and the UK, 68 storage terminals and service to more than 48 airports.

records.title: Information Services Corporation | La Caisse
records.description: Plenary Americas signed an all-cash arrangement agreement to acquire Information Services Corporation for C$51.00 per share, valuing ISC at about C$1.2bn enterprise value. ISC provides registry and information management services for public data and records, including land and business registry functions.

records.title: Eixo SP Co-Investment | Patria
records.description: Patria concluded an R$1.19bn asset-specific co-investment for Eixo SP, with Silk Road Fund as the sole investor and capital routed through a co-investment vehicle linked to Patria Infraestrutura IV. Eixo SP operates a 1,273 km Sao Paulo road concession spanning 12 highways and 62 municipalities, with a 30-year concession and R$14bn investment plan.

records.title: Maple Infrastructure Trust Units | Macquarie Asset Management / La Caisse
records.description: Macquarie Asset Management’s MAIF 4 vehicle agreed to acquire up to 177,289,950 Maple Infrastructure Trust units, alongside related Maple IM and Maple PM equity interests, from La Caisse’s CDPQ Infrastructures Asia III. Maple owns and operates Indian road assets through government concessions, giving the transaction a direct roads-infrastructure exposure.

records.title: Voltera / Revel Combined EV Charging Platform | EQT Infrastructure / GIP
records.target: Voltera / Revel Combined EV Charging Platform
records.description: EQT-backed Voltera and GIP-backed Revel entered into a definitive agreement to combine their businesses into an urban fast-charging infrastructure platform. The combined company is expected to include more than 1,000 charging stalls operational and under development across 11 major U.S. metro markets, with EQT as majority owner and GIP retaining a minority stake.

records.title: Five Indian Road SPVs | Actis
records.description: Nxt-Infra Trust’s investment manager approved execution of securities purchase agreements covering shareholdings and beneficial ownership in Darah Jhalawar Highways, Vadodara Kim Expressway, Calicut Expressway, Vindhyachal Expressway, and Second Vivekananda Bridge Tollway. The assets add a five-asset roads and bridge package to the Actis-sponsored long-life infrastructure vehicle.

records.title: 76 MWp Uruguay Solar Portfolio | Ardian
records.description: Ardian Clean Energy Evergreen Fund acquired two operating solar PV plants in Uruguay with a combined capacity of 76 MWp. The assets mark ACEEF’s entry into Uruguay and expand Ardian’s Latin American renewable-power footprint, with AGR-AM managing the portfolio.

records.title: Stoneworthy BESS Project | Equitix
records.description: Eelpower Energy, the Equitix-led battery-storage platform backed with Aware Super and the UK National Wealth Fund, acquired the 50 MW / 100 MWh Stoneworthy BESS project in Devon from RES. Construction is slated to begin in 2027, with commercial operations planned for 2028.

records.title: Cogent Fiber Data Center Portfolio | I Squared Capital
records.description: I Squared Capital entered into a definitive purchase and sale agreement to acquire ten data center facilities from Cogent Fiber for $225mm in cash. The 53 MW, 259,000-square-foot seed portfolio spans nine U.S. markets and anchors a new AI inference and edge colocation platform, with I Squared committing up to $1bn for expansion and follow-on acquisitions.

records.title: Lexington Data Center Campus | NOVA Infrastructure
records.description: NOVA-backed DartPoints acquired a Lexington, Kentucky data center campus spanning approximately 343,000 square feet on 29.5 acres, including about 81,000 square feet of existing raised-floor data center space and an owned on-site substation. The campus has a 20-30 MW initial path and longer-term expansion potential to 70 MW for AI, neo-cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads.

records.title: Naturgy Energy Group | CVC
records.description: CVC sold its entire 13.8% stake in Naturgy Energy Group through an accelerated bookbuild and related derivative settlement. The exit covered a Spanish integrated gas and power utility stake worth around €4bn at prevailing market prices and followed GIP / BlackRock’s earlier full exit from Naturgy.

records.title: Estia Health | Stonepeak
records.description: A Stonepeak-led consortium agreed to acquire a majority stake in Estia Health from Bain Capital, extending Stonepeak’s Volarae Living social-infrastructure platform in Australia and New Zealand. Estia is one of Australia’s largest residential aged-care operators, with more than 90 homes across four states and approximately 9,000 residents.

records.title: Vena Energy India | Global Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Vena Group entered into a definitive agreement to sell 100% of Vena Energy India Holdings to Inox Clean Energy. The India platform includes 5.4 GW of solar and wind assets and a 2.5 GWh BESS renewable-energy pipeline tied to GIP III's original infrastructure acquisition of Equis Energy.

records.title: Pathway Power | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Igneo completed a preferred equity investment in Pathway Power, a U.S. utility-scale renewable and storage development platform. Pathway has assembled more than 1 GW of projects expected to begin construction in 2026-2027, plus approximately 1,000 MW of early-stage hybrid interconnection positions across SPP and MISO.

records.title: Enderby Battery Storage Project | EIG
records.description: EIG-backed Fidra Energy acquired the Enderby battery storage project from Innova. The Leicestershire project is expected to deliver up to 1,025 MW once operational and increases Fidra's UK BESS pipeline to more than 4 GW.

records.title: Mountain Peak / Canyon Peak Power | Blackstone
records.description: TransAlta signed a purchase and sale agreement to acquire Mountain Peak Power and Canyon Peak Power from indirect subsidiaries of Blackstone. The transaction covers two fully contracted gas-fired peaking facilities in Colorado, adding dispatchable power capacity under existing contracts.

records.title: ACME Solar Holdings | ADIA
records.description: ACME Solar completed an INR 2,800 crore qualified institutional placement with ADIA named among participating investors. ACME develops, owns, operates, and maintains utility-scale renewable-energy projects across India.

records.title: GS Power Community Solar Portfolio | CVC DIF
records.description: CVC DIF-backed GS Power Partners secured $51mm of tax equity financing for a 41 MWdc community solar portfolio across New York, Maryland, and Illinois. The portfolio-company financing close adds equity capital to distributed solar infrastructure within DIF Infrastructure VII lineage.

records.title: Broadway Proper | Harrison Street
records.description: Harrison Street sold Broadway Proper, a 232-unit independent and assisted living community in Tucson, Arizona. Berkadia announced the completed sale during the target period, marking a realized social-infrastructure exit rather than a financing transaction.

records.title: Teleconsult and Meditecs | EQT Infrastructure
records.description: EQT Infrastructure-backed Evidia acquired Teleconsult and Meditecs as bolt-ons to its diagnostic imaging and radiology services platform. Evidia traces to EQT Infrastructure Fund V, and the acquisitions expand healthcare-services infrastructure in Europe.

records.title: LineoX | Asterion Industrial Partners
records.description: Telefonica reached an agreement to acquire LineoX, a rural microwave backhauling platform, from Asterion-backed Axion / LineoX. The transaction traces to Asterion Industrial Infra Fund I and adds digital connectivity infrastructure to Telefonica's rural network footprint.

records.title: CLI | Macquarie Asset Management
records.description: Macquarie Asset Management and IG4 signed a definitive agreement to sell a controlling stake in CLI - Corredor Logistica e Infraestrutura S.A. to AD Ports Group. The transaction values the Brazilian infrastructure and logistics operator at approximately US$835mm.

records.title: Delfin FLNG 1 | Global Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Delfin Midstream announced a $5bn final investment decision for Delfin FLNG 1, the first offshore LNG export facility in the United States. GIP, part of BlackRock, led the investor group committing equity alongside Vitol and other partners for the first phase of the project.

records.title: Mitsubishi HC Capital / Brookfield Renewables Platform | Brookfield Asset Management
records.target: Mitsubishi HC Capital / Brookfield Renewables Platform
records.description: Brookfield and Mitsubishi HC Capital launched a renewable-energy company seeded with 570 MW of contracted European wind and solar assets. Brookfield will operate the platform alongside Mitsubishi HC Capital, with the transaction carrying an initial equity value of approximately EUR400mm.

records.title: Vietnam Renewable Energy Partnership | Brookfield Asset Management
records.description: Brookfield and Foxconn formed a renewable-energy partnership in Vietnam targeting up to 1 GW of wind, solar, and battery storage. The platform is intended to support power supply for Foxconn and broader industrial customers as Vietnam adds contracted clean-power capacity.

records.title: Repsol Spanish Renewables Portfolio | Mubadala
records.description: Masdar agreed to acquire a 49.99% stake in a 705 MW operating Spanish renewables portfolio from Repsol. The transaction creates a partnership around mature wind and solar assets and links Mubadala through Masdar ownership lineage.

records.title: Devilla BESS Project | Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners
records.description: CIP agreed to sell minority stakes in the 500 MW Devilla battery energy storage project to Scottish National Investment Bank and Nuclear Liabilities Fund. CIP remains the majority owner through Copenhagen Infrastructure IV while recycling capital into a large-scale UK storage project.

records.title: Illinois Community Solar Portfolio | EQT Infrastructure
records.description: EQT-backed Cypress Creek Renewables sold a 104 MW Illinois community solar portfolio to 38 Degrees North. The portfolio comprises 16 projects across 14 counties and reflects continued sponsor portfolio rotation in distributed solar assets.

records.title: SK Group Renewable Energy JV | KKR
