records.description: SK and KKR signed a renewable-energy business transfer agreement covering solar and wind assets, with KKR expected to participate through asset acquisitions and capital contributions into an integrated renewable-energy entity. The deal adds sponsor capital to a Korean renewable platform with operating and development exposure.

records.title: Groupe Santé Sedna | Axium Infrastructure
records.description: An Axium-managed fund made a new equity investment in Groupe Santé Sedna, a Canadian healthcare and social-services platform. Advisor materials identified a June 11 closing, and the transaction was treated as in-period despite a prior Competition Bureau reference.

records.title: Dauntless Air | Ridgewood Infrastructure
records.description: Ridgewood Infrastructure acquired Dauntless Air, a provider of emergency-management infrastructure for wildfire response. The business supports aerial firefighting and mission-critical public-safety operations across North America.

records.title: Navitas Credit Corp. | Wafra
records.description: Wafra announced a definitive agreement to acquire Navitas Credit Corp., an equipment finance business. Navitas provides equipment financing to small and mid-sized businesses through vendor programs, strategic partnerships, and direct origination channels.

records.title: Helix Digital Infrastructure | KKR
records.description: KKR launched Helix Digital Infrastructure with partners as a new company to finance and deliver AI infrastructure. The platform announced more than $10bn of commitments targeting data centers, power, transmission and distribution, fiber, and connectivity assets.

records.title: Ansan Data Center Site / SEL5 | Stonepeak
records.description: Stonepeak-backed Digital Edge secured a fully powered land parcel in Ansan, South Korea for its planned SEL5 data center. The site supports a 60 MW development in a power-constrained market and expands Digital Edge’s Seoul-area data-center pipeline.

records.title: A25 Concession | La Caisse
records.description: La Caisse agreed to acquire Transurban’s remaining 50% interest in the A25 Concession, increasing its ownership from 50% to 100%. The Montreal-area asset includes toll road and bridge infrastructure under a long-term concession framework.

records.title: University of Kentucky Central Utility Plant | La Caisse
records.target: University of Kentucky Central Utility Plant
records.description: Kentucky Infrastructure Partners reached financial close on the University of Kentucky Central Utility Plant P3 project. The deal includes sponsor equity alongside bond financing and is linked to La Caisse through Plenary Americas infrastructure-platform lineage.

records.title: Anwim / MOYA Fuel Station Network | Stonepeak
records.description: Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners agreed to acquire Anwim, operator of the MOYA fuel station network in Poland. The transaction gives Stonepeak direct exposure to fuel distribution and logistics infrastructure with a national retail and wholesale platform.

records.title: Altavair Aircraft Leasing Portfolio | KKR
records.description: KKR committed US$1.4bn of equity to continue expanding its global leased commercial aircraft portfolio with Altavair. The new commitment builds on two prior aircraft leasing portfolios and is expected to be funded primarily through KKR's Infrastructure and Asset-Based Finance strategies.

records.title: LOGISTEC Marine Terminal Division | Stonepeak
records.description: Stonepeak-backed Enstructure agreed to acquire LOGISTEC's marine terminal operations from Blue Wolf Capital Partners. The combination will create a North American terminal network spanning LOGISTEC, Gulf Stream Marine, and LOGISTEC Direct assets serving major trade corridors and industrial markets.

records.title: Electrada Assets | Macquarie Asset Management
records.description: Macquarie-backed Inspiration Mobility Group acquired select assets of Electrada, adding fleet electrification technology, charging infrastructure development capabilities, and an experienced team to its Inspiration Energy platform. The acquisition expands Inspiration's end-to-end electric fuel solution for commercial fleets.

records.title: Kinship Marina Ventura | Wafra
records.description: Wafra-backed Suntex Marinas acquired Kinship Marina in Ventura, California, expanding its West Coast marina footprint. The coastal asset adds wet slips, dry storage, on-site service partnerships, and access to the Channel Islands boating market.

records.title: Beatrice Offshore Wind Farm | Equitix / InfraRed Capital Partners
records.description: The Renewables Infrastructure Group received a binding offer to sell its full 17.5% stake in the 588 MW Beatrice offshore wind farm to funds managed by Equitix for approximately GBP155mm. The transaction recycles capital from a mature Scottish offshore wind asset and is expected to reduce TRIG's revolving credit facility drawings.

records.title: Greenlink Interconnector | Mubadala
records.description: Mubadala acquired US$200mm of Equitix's stake in Greenlink, the 504 MW subsea electricity interconnector linking Great Britain and Ireland. The regulated HVDC asset spans approximately 190 km and supports cross-border power flows, renewables integration, and system flexibility.

records.title: Inkia Energy | I Squared Capital
records.description: ALTERRA entered a co-investment in Inkia Energy alongside I Squared Capital through an I Squared-managed continuation vehicle. Inkia is Peru's largest independent power producer, operating 2.6 GW of generation capacity and supporting a 4 GW renewables pipeline, including approximately 1 GW of near-term solar and wind projects.

records.title: CtrlS Datacenters | CPP Investments
records.description: CPP Investments committed up to C$1bn to CtrlS Datacenters, including INR 40bn, or approximately C$588mm, to acquire an 8.2% stake in the company. The partnership also includes a 48% CPP Investments interest in a new platform to develop hyperscale data center campuses across India.

records.title: Transcend Towers Infrastructure | BCI
records.description: BCI-backed Frontier Towers completed its acquisition of American Tower's Philippine tower portfolio through Transcend Towers Infrastructure. The transaction adds approximately 400 towers and expands Frontier's nationwide footprint to more than 6,500 sites.

records.title: KAPS Pipeline System | Stonepeak
records.description: Keyera acquired Stonepeak's remaining 50% non-operating interest in the KAPS Pipeline System for C$1.215bn. KAPS is a natural gas liquids pipeline system connecting Montney and Duvernay production to downstream markets, and Keyera now owns 100% of the asset.

records.title: Pinnacle Gas Services | Sixth Street
records.description: Sixth Street invested US$600mm for a 27% minority equity interest in Comstock Resources' midstream subsidiary Pinnacle Gas Services. Pinnacle owns and operates natural gas gathering and treating systems supporting Comstock's Western Haynesville development.

records.title: ThamesWey Central Milton Keynes | Ancala Partners
records.description: Ancala-backed Leep Utilities acquired ThamesWey Central Milton Keynes from ThamesWey Energy. TCMK provides district heating and private-wire electricity network services to domestic and business customers in central Milton Keynes, including mixed-use developments and office assets.

records.title: Waste Eliminator / Liberty Waste Solutions | TPG
records.description: TPG signed definitive agreements to acquire Waste Eliminator and Liberty Waste Solutions from Allied Industrial Partners through TPG Transition Infrastructure. The combination is expected to serve commercial, industrial, municipal, and residential customers across the Southeastern U.S. with 14 permitted facilities and more than 500 fleet vehicles.

records.title: EDF Power Solutions U.S. and Canada operations | KKR
records.target: EDF Power Solutions U.S. and Canada operations
records.description: EDF signed an agreement for KKR to acquire EDF Power Solutions assets and operations in the U.S. and Canada, including renewable power, storage, EV charging, and microgrid activities. The transaction gives KKR a scaled North American clean power operating platform.

records.title: Tormes Solar and Alamo BESS projects | TPG
records.target: Tormes Solar and Alamo BESS projects
records.description: TPG-backed Matrix Renewables secured a $210mm preferred equity commitment from DESRI for the Tormes Solar and Alamo BESS construction portfolio. The financing supports U.S. solar and battery storage development through an existing renewable infrastructure platform.

records.title: Terra-Gen | Igneo Infrastructure Partners / Pantheon
records.description: Pantheon Infrastructure committed approximately $55mm to Terra-Gen through an Igneo-managed co-investment vehicle. Terra-Gen owns and develops utility-scale wind, solar, and battery storage assets across the U.S. power market.

records.title: Gennaker offshore wind project | BlackRock / GIP
records.description: Skyborn Renewables agreed to sell Stadtwerke München a 25% equity interest in the Gennaker offshore wind project. Skyborn is a GIP infrastructure portfolio company within BlackRock’s infrastructure platform, and Gennaker is positioned as a major German Baltic Sea offshore wind development.

records.title: Yarnton BESS | Schroders Greencoat
records.description: A Schroders Greencoat / Wessex Gardens renewable infrastructure fund acquired the 50 MW Yarnton battery energy storage system in Oxfordshire from Rivington Energy. The transaction adds a grid-scale storage asset in a constrained UK power market.

records.title: Gresham House UK solar portfolio | True Green Capital Management
records.description: A UK entity managed by True Green Capital acquired a 20.3 MWdc operating solar portfolio from Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT 1 and VCT 2. The portfolio adds contracted operating solar assets to True Green’s European distributed generation footprint.

records.title: TerraWind / Sym Energy Miyazaki wind JV | Stonepeak
records.target: TerraWind / Sym Energy Miyazaki wind JV
records.description: Stonepeak-backed TerraWind Renewables formed a jointly owned special purpose company with Sym Energy for wind development in Miyazaki, Japan. TerraWind is an onshore wind platform in which Stonepeak holds an 80% interest.

records.title: Specialist Fleet Services | Astatine Investment Partners
records.description: Astatine-backed NRG Riverside / NRG Fleet Services agreed to acquire the entire issued share capital of Specialist Fleet Services from Paragon Banking Group. SFS adds specialist contract hire, fleet management, and municipal fleet capabilities to NRG Riverside’s UK platform.

records.title: Integmar Marine Technologies | Antin Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Antin-backed Consilium Safety Group acquired Integmar Marine Technologies, expanding its presence in Türkiye and its marine safety technology offering. Consilium was acquired by an Antin Flagship Fund V affiliate, bringing the bolt-on into an infrastructure-backed safety platform.

records.title: Southern Water | Asterion Industrial Partners / Macquarie Asset Management
records.buyer: Asterion Industrial Partners / Macquarie Asset Management
records.description: Asterion joined a Macquarie-led consortium committing GBP1.2bn of equity support to Southern Water, including Asterion’s approximately GBP300mm commitment for an approximately 20% minority shareholding. The transaction supports a regulated UK water and wastewater utility’s investment programme.

records.title: Amprion indirect stake | Swiss Life Asset Managers
records.description: Swiss Life Asset Managers signed an agreement to sell an indirect stake in Amprion, one of Germany’s major electricity transmission system operators. The sale recycles capital from a regulated power transmission asset held through the manager’s infrastructure platform.

records.title: Eurofiber Netz Berlin | Antin Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Antin-backed Eurofiber sold Eurofiber Netz GmbH in Berlin to MIH Group, effective June 22, 2026. The business develops and operates fiber-to-the-home infrastructure in the Berlin metropolitan area with more than 150,000 homes passed.

records.title: Roseton Generating Facility | Partners Group
records.description: Partners Group-backed PowerTransitions agreed to acquire the 1,242 MW Roseton Generating Facility in New York. The add-on expands the platform's operating power-generation footprint in a capacity-constrained U.S. market.

records.title: Greenlight Electricity Centre | Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Pembina, MSIP, and Kineticor reached FID on the 932 MW Greenlight Electricity Centre in Alberta. MSIP acquired OPTrust's 50% interest, taking a 47.5% project stake, with remaining costs funded partly through owner equity contributions.

records.title: Dion BESS | Macquarie Asset Management
records.description: Eku Energy announced its German market entry through acquisition and development rights for the 400 MW / 1,600 MWh Dion battery storage project in Lamspringe. Eku is owned by BCI and a Macquarie Asset Management-managed fund.

records.title: SK / KKR Korea renewables platform | KKR
records.description: KKR and SK signed definitive agreements to establish a renewable-energy platform in South Korea. The investment is tied to KKR's Asia Pacific infrastructure strategy and targets power-transition assets in a high-demand market.

records.title: Kallista Energy | APG / Ardian
records.description: APG, on behalf of its infrastructure pool and alongside PKZH, acquired Ardian's remaining 38% interest in Kallista Energy. The transaction moves a French onshore wind, solar, and battery-storage platform from Ardian ownership to APG-led control.

records.title: Klara Renewables | Actis / CVC DIF
records.description: Actis agreed to acquire Klara Renewables from CVC DIF, launching a Polish renewables platform anchored by 171 MW of operating onshore wind assets. The portfolio also carries solar PV and battery-storage hybridization potential.

records.title: Nordergrunde offshore wind farm | Global Infrastructure Partners
records.description: GIP-backed Skyborn Renewables agreed to acquire the remaining 70% equity interest in the Nordergrunde offshore wind farm. The transaction gives Skyborn full ownership of the German operating asset and deepens its offshore wind platform.

records.title: Enersol solar portfolio | La Caisse / Equitix
records.description: La Caisse-backed Velto Renewables agreed to acquire Equitix's minority stake in the Enersol solar portfolio in Andalusia. The deal gives Velto full ownership of nine operating PV assets totaling 45 MWp.

records.title: Cobirgy biogas plant | CIP
records.description: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners took FID on Cobirgy through Advanced Bioenergy Fund I. The project adds large-scale Spanish biomethane and biogas infrastructure to CIP's energy-transition portfolio.

records.title: EQT AI Infrastructure / EdgeConneX | CPP Investments
records.description: CPP Investments closed a US$1.75bn investment alongside EQT to support global digital infrastructure growth led by EdgeConneX. The transaction provides scaled equity backing for AI-driven data-center expansion.

records.title: Northern Virginia data centers | Blackstone
records.description: Digital Realty agreed to purchase Blackstone-affiliated funds' blended 64% equity interest in three fully leased Northern Virginia data centers. The facilities represent 288 MW of IT capacity in the leading U.S. data-center market.

records.title: ITG Inc. | Oaktree Capital
records.description: Oaktree-backed ITG priced its U.S. IPO and began public trading on Nasdaq during the target week. The listing crystallizes public-market equity access for a digital infrastructure platform backed by Oaktree's power and infrastructure strategy.

records.title: Lefdal Mine Datacenter | 3i Infrastructure
records.description: 3i Infrastructure agreed to acquire a further 23% stake in Lefdal Mine Datacenter alongside 3i-managed co-investors. LMD is an operating Norwegian data-center campus built around low-cost renewable power and cavern-based infrastructure.

records.title: Nippon Gateway Infrastructure | DigitalBridge
records.description: DigitalBridge and JEXI formed Nippon Gateway Infrastructure, a new Japanese colocation data-center platform. NGI launched with data-center assets acquired from NEC and is positioned for Japan's digital infrastructure demand.

records.title: Kao Data | Infratil
records.description: Siemens Financial Services made a minority equity investment in Kao Data, the UK data-center platform backed by Infratil and Legal & General. The capital supports expansion of Kao's high-performance computing and AI-ready campus footprint.

records.title: I-2SEA submarine cable system | I Squared Capital
records.description: I Squared-backed Lightstorm signed a joint build agreement with Microsoft for the I-2SEA submarine cable system. The project adds new India-to-Southeast Asia subsea capacity for cloud, AI, and enterprise connectivity demand.

records.title: Volta Data Centres | Ardian
records.description: Ardian-backed Verne agreed to sell 100% of Volta Data Centres to Arcus European Infrastructure Fund 4. Volta operates a central London data center and gives Arcus an established urban colocation asset.

records.title: Ubiquity Southern California fiber network | Brookfield / Generate Capital
records.description: Brookfield Infrastructure-backed Intrepid Fiber Networks agreed to acquire Ubiquity's Southern California fiber network. The deal transfers FTTP network assets from Generate-backed Ubiquity to an active U.S. fiber expansion platform.

records.title: UK passenger rolling stock platform | Partners Group
records.description: Partners Group made a co-lead infrastructure secondaries investment in a UK passenger rolling stock leasing platform. The platform comprises more than 1,500 vehicles contracted into the UK rail system.

records.title: Ocean Yield | KKR
records.description: A.P. Moller Holding agreed to acquire 100% of Ocean Yield from KKR-managed funds. Ocean Yield owns maritime infrastructure assets under long-term charters, making the sale a full exit from KKR's shipping-infrastructure platform.

records.title: Avenue Capital aviation leasing portfolio | Partners Group
records.description: Partners Group invested US$250mm as sole lead investor in a continuation vehicle acquiring a global commercial aviation leasing portfolio. The contracted aircraft-leasing exposure fits the firm's infrastructure secondaries strategy.

records.title: GeniePoint EV charging locations | EQT Infrastructure
records.description: EQT-backed InstaVolt agreed to acquire 228 GeniePoint EV charging locations from Equans. The transaction adds more than 260 chargers and moves InstaVolt past 1,000 UK sites.

records.title: InstaVolt Iberian EV charging business | Antin / EQT Infrastructure
records.description: Antin-backed Powerdot agreed to acquire InstaVolt's Spanish and Portuguese operations from EQT-backed InstaVolt. The divestiture transfers the Iberian charging network and related employees to a regional EV infrastructure platform.

records.title: Genus Power Infrastructures | GIC
records.description: GIC sold an 11.03% equity stake in Genus Power Infrastructures through an open-market block transaction. Genus supplies smart-metering and utility digitalization infrastructure, making the sale a secondary equity rotation in the power distribution value chain.

records.title: Drammen Fjernvarme | Vauban Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Vauban-backed Oslofjord Varme agreed to acquire Å Energi's remaining 50% stake in Drammen Fjernvarme. The transaction moves the Norwegian district-heating business to full Oslofjord Varme ownership.

records.title: Cardinal Midstream Delaware Basin assets | EnCap Flatrock Midstream
records.description: EnCap Flatrock-backed Cardinal Midstream agreed to sell Cardinal Delaware Basin and Cardinal New Mexico to San Mateo Midstream for US$752mm. The assets include natural gas gathering and processing infrastructure in the Delaware Basin.

records.title: Great Bay Renewables | Apollo
records.description: Apollo Infrastructure Funds signed an agreement to sell their 50% membership interests in Great Bay Renewables to Northampton Capital Partners for approximately US$390 million. The divestiture transfers Apollo's stake in the renewable-energy royalty platform.

records.title: Copia Power | EQT Infrastructure / Carlyle Infrastructure
records.description: EQT Infrastructure VII agreed to acquire Copia Power from Carlyle Infrastructure. The platform has 2.6 GW of generation and storage operating or under construction, with more than 9 GW of data-center development supported by over 25 GW of solar and storage and 7 GW of gas generation.

records.title: Harmony Energy | Energy Infrastructure Partners
records.description: EIP-backed Alpiq agreed to acquire 90% of Harmony Energy, with co-founder and CEO Peter Kavanagh retaining 10%. The platform adds approximately 400 MW under construction and a pipeline exceeding 12 GW across the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Poland.

records.title: Schwarzholz Agri-PV Park | EQT Infrastructure
records.description: EQT Active Core Infrastructure-backed Tion Renewables acquired the operational Schwarzholz Agri-PV park from FEFA. The 69 MWp asset is expected to generate approximately 87 GWh annually, equivalent to the electricity needs of about 25,000 homes.

records.title: NuGen C&I Solar Portfolio | Argo Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Argo acquired eight operating commercial and industrial solar sites from NuGen, including six in Massachusetts and two in New Jersey. The add-on expands Argo's distributed-solar platform to 196 sites and approximately 270 MW of operating capacity.

records.title: Lemvig Biogas | APG
records.description: APG-backed BioticNRG acquired Lemvig Biogas, an industrial-scale Danish facility operating since 1992. BioticNRG plans to upgrade the plant to produce biomethane for injection into Denmark's gas grid.

records.title: Nicollin Environnement | Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners
records.description: MSIP committed to acquire a majority stake in Nicollin Environnement, with the Nicollin family remaining invested. The French platform serves approximately 360 public contracts and 8,000 private clients with 4,800 employees, 2,900 vehicles and a national network of environmental-infrastructure sites.

records.title: Paprec Metabader | Swiss Life Asset Managers / UBS Asset Management
records.buyer: Swiss Life Asset Managers / UBS Asset Management
records.description: Paprec Swiss Group combined with Metabader to create Paprec Metabader, which has 31 plants and agencies across Switzerland. Jessy Bader became CEO and a shareholder; the combined company’s capital includes an infrastructure fund managed by Swiss Life Asset Managers and UBS Asset Management.

records.title: Kundl Campus Infrastructure & Site Services | Swiss Life Asset Managers
records.description: Swiss Life- and Gelsenwasser-backed INNEXIS agreed to acquire selected infrastructure facilities, assets and real estate-related services at the Kundl Life Science Campus from Novartis, with 30 employees transferring. The acquired perimeter spans approximately 264,000 square metres and more than 100 buildings; Novartis will retain the research and production facilities.

records.title: Milestone Environmental | I Squared Capital
records.description: I Squared Capital's flagship fund agreed to acquire Milestone Environmental from SK Capital. The platform owns and operates 15 fully permitted disposal facilities across major U.S. energy basins and manages approximately one billion gallons of waste annually across the energy and industrial sectors.

records.title: Sabey Data Center Properties | Ares Management
records.description: Ares Secondaries funds made a minority equity investment in Sabey Data Center Properties. The U.S. platform spans six energized campuses with approximately 251 MW of operating capacity and more than four million square feet of mission-critical space.

records.title: Northern Fiber Holding | iCON Infrastructure
records.description: iCON-backed Strategic Fiber Networks agreed to acquire Northern Fiber Holding in a share deal. Operating through the Lünecom and sewikom brands, Northern Fiber manages owned and leased networks serving rural and semi-urban communities across three German states.

records.title: D-Marin | InfraVia Capital Partners
records.description: InfraVia European Fund VI agreed to acquire D-Marin from CVC alongside management. The premium-marina platform operates and develops 28 marinas with more than 14,300 berths across nine countries.

records.title: Helen EV Charging Business | CVC DIF
records.description: CVC DIF-backed Plugit acquired Helen’s electric-vehicle charging business. The network includes 199 public charging stations and 798 charge points, with more than 55,000 registered users transferring to Plugit’s platform.

records.title: Dresser Utility Solutions | Blackstone / First Reserve
records.description: Funds managed by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners agreed to acquire Dresser Utility Solutions from First Reserve. The approximately 850-employee business supplies measurement, instrumentation and control products for natural-gas and water infrastructure globally; terms were not disclosed.

records.title: MidOcean Energy | EIG
records.description: The Private Department of Sheikh Mohammed bin Khalid Al Nahyan committed US$1.13 billion to MidOcean Energy, the global LNG company formed and managed by EIG. The investment expands MidOcean’s institutional shareholder base and supports the platform’s LNG growth strategy.

records.title: Sprng Energy | GIP
records.description: GIP-backed Aditya Birla Renewables signed an agreement to acquire 100% of Solenergi, including the Sprng Energy group, from Shell for US$1.8 billion. The platform comprises 5.0 GWp of Indian solar and wind assets, including 3.3 GWp operating and 1.7 GWp contracted.

records.title: Summit Ridge Energy | GIP
records.description: GIP Mid-Market Funds agreed to acquire a majority and controlling interest in Summit Ridge Energy. The U.S. commercial solar and storage platform owns and operates more than 275 facilities serving over 60,000 businesses, homes and municipalities.

records.title: Formosa 2 Offshore Wind Farm | PSP Investments
records.description: PSP Investments and JERA Nex bp will acquire joint control of Formosa 2 through a purchase of shares, according to an EU merger notice published July 16. The operating Taiwanese offshore wind farm has 376 MW of capacity.

records.title: Tuscania BESS Portfolio | J.P. Morgan Asset Management
records.description: J.P. Morgan Asset Management-backed Sonnedix acquired two adjacent standalone BESS projects in Tuscania from Sphera Energy. The 160 MW and 100 MW four-hour projects add 260 MW / 1,040 MWh to Sonnedix’s Italian portfolio.

records.title: SELCHP | MEAG / iCON Infrastructure
records.description: MEAG acquired iCON Infrastructure Partners IV’s 49.78% stake in the South East London Combined Heat and Power plant. Veolia remains co-owner and operator of the facility, which receives contracted waste volumes and generates power-offtake revenue.

records.title: ClearGen C&I Solar Portfolio | CBRE Investment Management
records.description: CBRE Investment Management-backed ClearGen acquired 100% of the equity interests in ten operating behind-the-meter solar projects from Tortoise Capital affiliates. The 19 MW portfolio spans California, Colorado, Florida, Massachusetts and New Jersey.

records.title: EcoEridania | CVC DIF / iCON Infrastructure
records.description: CVC DIF agreed to acquire a majority stake in EcoEridania through DIF Infrastructure VIII, including the indirect purchase of iCON’s 75% interest. The integrated Italian waste platform served approximately 27,000 clients through 22 facilities and managed 1.3 million tons of waste in 2025.

records.title: All American Tire / Colt Tire Recycling / Genan | I Squared Capital
records.target: All American Tire / Colt Tire Recycling / Genan
records.description: I Squared-backed Liberty Tire Recycling completed three acquisitions: All American Tire, Colt Tire Recycling and Genan Inc. The bolt-ons expand Liberty’s collection and recycling coverage across Gulf Coast markets and reinforce its environmental-infrastructure platform.

records.title: Cyntox Biohazard Solutions | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Igneo acquired Cyntox Biohazard Solutions as one of two initial investments forming a regulated U.S. medical-waste platform. The combined platform will integrate collection, treatment and disposal services across the Central, Midwest and Northeast regions.

records.title: AdvoWaste Medical Services | Igneo Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Igneo separately acquired AdvoWaste Medical Services as the second founding business in its new North American medical-waste platform. AdvoWaste and Cyntox have complementary footprints and serve small and medium waste generators including clinics, veterinary practices and nursing homes.

records.title: Raxio Group | Meridiam
records.description: Meridiam and Roha provided additional equity to Raxio and increased their stakes, lifting the African data-center platform’s committed capital from US$350 million to more than US$380 million. Raxio operates Tier III carrier-neutral facilities in six countries with Tanzania under development.

records.title: TIP Group | I Squared Capital / IMCO / GCM Grosvenor
records.seller: I Squared Capital / IMCO / GCM Grosvenor
records.description: I Squared agreed to sell a combined 25% stake in TIP Group to IMCO and GCM Grosvenor. TIP operates approximately 90,000 trailers, trucks and specialized assets from more than 130 service locations in 17 countries, serving over 15,000 European transportation and logistics customers.

records.title: Delfin FLNG2 | EIG
records.description: EIG-managed MidOcean Energy entered into agreements to acquire up to a 50% interest in Delfin’s second floating LNG vessel. The transaction remains subject to a positive final investment decision and customary conditions while advancing U.S. Gulf Coast LNG export capacity.

records.title: Aypa Power | Brookfield / Blackstone
records.description: Brookfield agreed to acquire Aypa Power from Blackstone for approximately US$7 billion of enterprise value, including US$3 billion of equity value. Aypa has approximately 6.5 GW of operating, under-construction and contracted battery-storage capacity and a development pipeline exceeding 20 GW.

records.title: Cubico–CFE Mexico JV | Ontario Teachers / PSP
records.description: Ontario Teachers- and PSP-owned Cubico signed a 25-year joint venture agreement with CFE covering five renewable projects totaling 578 MWac plus 175.7 MW / 500 MWh of battery storage. The partnership is expected to unlock nearly US$1 billion of investment across Tamaulipas, Nuevo León, Campeche and the Yucatán Peninsula.

records.title: Greenbacker Renewable Energy Company | Ridgewood
records.description: Ridgewood-backed MN8 Energy signed a definitive cash-and-equity agreement to acquire Greenbacker for up to approximately US$375 million. The combination would create a clean-power platform with more than 6 GW of operating and under-construction capacity across 33 states.

records.title: Yanara | Mirova
records.description: Mirova committed €150 million to Yanara to accelerate more than 2 GW of utility-scale renewable infrastructure across Victoria, New South Wales and Western Australia. The portfolio includes the 450 MW solar and 600 MW / 2,400 MWh Mortlake Energy Hub.

records.title: Burton Wold & Winscales Moor Wind Farms | Tiger Infrastructure
records.target: Burton Wold & Winscales Moor Wind Farms
records.description: Tiger Infrastructure-backed Forsa Energy acquired the operational Burton Wold and Winscales Moor wind farms from GCP Infra for approximately £11 million. The 17-turbine portfolio totals approximately 26.5 MW and expands Forsa’s UK independent-power-producer platform to 324.5 MW.

records.title: Vena Energy KN Wind Power | GIP
records.description: Orient Cement approved the acquisition of a 9.04% interest in both the ordinary and cumulative convertible preference share capital of GIP-backed Vena Energy KN Wind Power for ₹1.234 million. The target owns a 46 MW wind project in Karnataka that will supply contracted renewable power for captive use.

records.title: Five Virginia Community Solar Projects | ECP / TPG
records.description: TPG-backed Altus Power acquired five under-development Virginia community-solar projects totaling 32 MW from ECP-backed New Leaf Energy. The projects will serve Appalachian Power’s shared-solar program and are expected to provide power equivalent to the needs of approximately 5,000 homes.

records.title: Caruna | KKR / Ontario Teachers
records.description: Iberdrola agreed to acquire KKR’s and Ontario Teachers’ respective 40% holdings in Caruna for approximately €2 billion, valuing the Finnish electricity distributor at about €5 billion including debt. Caruna operates roughly 89,000 km of network and serves 1.5 million people.

records.title: Uluğ Enerji | Actis
records.description: IFC and Proparco agreed to become minority equity investors in Actis-controlled Uluğ Enerji, with Actis retaining a majority stake. The electricity distribution and retail group serves more than three million customers across four provinces under an exclusive concession through 2036.

records.title: OIL! Tankstellen | KKR
records.description: KKR-backed Enilive signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of OIL! Tankstellen from Prax. The network comprises approximately 320 service stations across four European markets and expands Enilive’s retail platform for conventional and lower-emission fuels, electric charging and related mobility services.

records.title: GO.FARM Permanent Crops Platform | La Caisse
records.description: La Caisse committed A$300 million and GO.FARM A$30 million to launch an Australian irrigated permanent-crops platform, while La Caisse will also acquire a minority stake in GO.FARM. The manager oversees approximately A$1.6 billion of assets focused on institutional-scale land and water operations.

records.title: California Solar & BESS Portfolio | Ares
records.description: Ares agreed to acquire an 80% common-equity interest in a California portfolio totaling 384 MW, comprising 200 MW of solar and 184 MW of battery storage. EDPR reported an approximately US$800mm enterprise value and US$450mm of expected proceeds.

records.title: RWE U.S. Distributed Clean Energy | GSAM
records.description: GSAM agreed to acquire RWE’s U.S. distributed clean-energy business, including 348 MWdc of operating assets and a 1.2 GW development pipeline. The transaction transfers an established commercial-and-industrial generation platform to GSAM’s infrastructure strategy.

records.title: U.S. Distributed Solar Portfolio | ArcLight
records.description: ArcLight-backed REC Power completed the acquisition of 15 operating distributed-generation solar projects totaling 68 MW from Adapture Renewables. The portfolio broadens REC Power’s contracted operating base across U.S. power markets.

records.title: Green Squares / Vertis Rooftop Solar | Igneo
records.description: Igneo launched Vertis Energy with the acquisition of Green Squares Energy and two follow-on portfolios totaling 46 MW of rooftop solar. The assets establish an operating distributed-energy platform serving Australian commercial and industrial customers.

records.title: Fukushima Wind Project | Stonepeak
records.description: Stonepeak-backed TerraWind acquired an approximately 25 MW onshore-wind project in Fukushima Prefecture. The purchase expands TerraWind’s Japanese development pipeline to 376 MW.

records.title: Múlavirkjun | Ancala
records.description: Ancala-backed HS Orka acquired the 3.2 MW Múlavirkjun hydropower plant in Iceland. The bolt-on adds an operating renewable asset to HS Orka’s domestic generation portfolio.

records.title: Wayu Energy | IFM
records.description: IFM Net Zero Infrastructure Fund-backed Nala Renewables sold its 80% interest in Wayu Energy to Kaffee Energy Limited. The divestiture advances Nala’s geographic refocus while transferring the Vietnam- and Philippines-focused renewable-power platform to a new owner.

records.title: Meta El Paso Data Center Campus | BlackRock / GIP
records.target: Meta El Paso Data Center Campus
records.description: Meta formed a strategic venture with a BlackRock-led investor group to develop a 1 GW data-center campus in El Paso, Texas. The investor group will own 80% of the approximately US$14bn project, providing direct capital for hyperscale digital infrastructure.

records.title: Westconnect | Igneo
records.description: Igneo contributed new shareholder equity to Westconnect alongside a €1.2bn financing package supporting the company’s fiber rollout. Westconnect has passed more than 1mm households; the equity component was not separately disclosed.

records.title: Yondr Slough Campus | La Caisse / DigitalBridge
records.description: La Caisse- and DigitalBridge-owned Yondr brought GLIL Infrastructure into its Slough data-center campus through an investment in two operational buildings. The buildings represent more than 60 MW within the campus’ greater-than-100 MW footprint.

records.title: Greenergy Data Centers | Amber
records.description: Amber-managed 3SIIF admitted Tensor Ventures as a minority investor in MCF Group, the owner of Greenergy Data Centers, while retaining majority control. The investment adds growth capital to the operator of the Baltics’ largest data center.

records.title: Cube Highways Trust | ADIA / BCI / I Squared
records.description: ADIA-, BCI- and I Squared-backed Cube Highways Trust began public trading following a ₹5,000 crore issue. The infrastructure investment trust owns 27 operational road assets and debuted with a reported market capitalization of ₹21,045 crore.

records.title: Crosby Marine Transportation | Tallvine
records.description: Tallvine affiliate Breakwater Buyer LLC signed a US$75mm stalking-horse agreement for Crosby Marine Transportation’s marine-transportation and dredging business. The proposed purchase remains subject to the bankruptcy auction process and court approval.

records.title: Contracted Container Portfolio | Brookfield
records.description: Brookfield Infrastructure disclosed the completed sale of a 67% interest across contracted intermodal-container programs representing more than one-quarter of the related fleet. The transaction generated US$60mm of proceeds at Brookfield Infrastructure’s share.

records.title: Sølvtrans | Antin
records.description: Antin agreed to sell a 30% interest in Sølvtrans to GLIL Infrastructure while retaining majority control. The aquaculture wellboat operator has expanded from 21 vessels at Antin’s investment to a 48-vessel fleet.

records.title: Kuwait Oil Pipeline Network | Blackstone / Brookfield / KKR
records.description: A Blackstone-, Brookfield- and KKR-led consortium agreed a US$16bn partnership over Kuwait Oil Company’s 13-pipeline, 320-kilometer crude-oil network. The investors will own 49% of a newly formed infrastructure company, generating US$7.85bn of proceeds for KOC while operations remain with the state producer.

records.title: SeaSeaS Amsterdam CO₂ Terminal | IMCO
records.description: IMCO-backed Exolum acquired a minority interest in the SeaSeaS Amsterdam CO₂ terminal project. The planned terminal is designed to handle 3.5mm tonnes of CO₂ annually and is expected to begin operations in 2030.

records.title: Epic Energy | MSIP / QIC
records.description: MSIP agreed to acquire Epic Energy from QIC Infrastructure. The transaction transfers an established Australian gas-pipeline and energy-infrastructure operator with a 50-year operating history; financial terms were not disclosed.

records.title: DCC Energy | ECP / KKR
records.description: ECP and KKR announced a recommended acquisition of DCC Energy valuing its equity at £5.75bn. The take-private would transfer a diversified energy-distribution platform serving customers across multiple European markets to infrastructure ownership.

records.title: Tarchon Interconnector | CPP Investments / CIP
records.description: CPP Investments agreed to commit approximately C$1bn for a majority interest in Tarchon, a proposed 1.4 GW electricity interconnector between the United Kingdom and Germany. WindGrid will hold a 25% look-through minority interest, and Copenhagen Infrastructure V, managed by CIP, is the seller.

records.title: TotalEnergies European Renewables Portfolio | KKR
records.description: KKR agreed to acquire a 50% interest in TotalEnergies’ largely developed 1.2 GW European onshore solar and wind portfolio at a €1.8bn enterprise value. TotalEnergies will retain 50%, continue operating the assets and market their power.

records.title: AVK Power Solutions | Partners Group
records.description: Partners Group agreed to acquire a majority stake in AVK through its fourth direct infrastructure program, with management retaining a minority interest, and plans to invest more than US$1bn of equity. AVK has delivered more than 20,000 projects representing c.3.5 GW of installed power and has a pipeline above 2 GW.

records.title: Enpal Residential Energy Systems Portfolio | Equitix / Keppel Infrastructure Trust / MM Capital Partners
records.buyer: Equitix / Keppel Infrastructure Trust / MM Capital Partners
records.description: The infrastructure-fund consortium, also including Mizuho Leasing, acquired 90% of Enpal subsidiaries holding more than 20,000 operating residential energy systems; Enpal retains 10% and remains the operator. Up to €65mm of new capital will support a portfolio with projected capacity of c.240 MW.

records.title: Verdant Energy / Aura Power | CVC DIF
records.description: CVC DIF-backed Verdant Energy and Aura Power merged to form a UK independent power producer with c.1 GW of operating and under-construction solar and battery assets and a c.10 GW development pipeline. CVC DIF invested through DIF Infrastructure VII, while Aura Power’s founder retains a minority stake.

records.title: Bioforce | Amber Infrastructure
records.description: Amber-advised Three Seas Initiative Investment Fund invested expansion capital in Bioforce, Estonia’s leading biomethane producer. Bioforce has three operating plants and a fourth commissioning toward combined output above 250 GWh, with a plan to reach 1 TWh by 2032 through Baltic and Polish expansion.

records.title: Cella | I Squared Capital
records.description: I Squared entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Cella, an Indonesian industrial-logistics and cold-storage platform. Cella owns and operates five facilities totaling approximately 231,000 square meters across major Indonesian distribution markets.

records.title: Rail Modal Group | InfraRed Capital Partners
records.description: InfraRed acquired a majority stake in Rail Modal Group through its value-add infrastructure strategy, with founder Greg Oberting remaining invested and serving as CEO. The platform operates four U.S. inland intermodal terminals and has shipped more than 1,200 full-length unit trains, equivalent to approximately 200mm truck miles.

records.title: Massachusetts Central Railroad / Wildwood Reload | 3i
records.description: 3i-backed Regional Rail acquired the 28-mile Massachusetts Central Railroad and Wildwood Reload’s warehousing and transloading operations. The bolt-on extends a network that now reaches 18 railroads across 10 U.S. states and two Canadian provinces.

records.title: Hainesport Transportation Group | Terramont Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Terramont acquired a majority stake in Hainesport Transportation Group, which combines a short-line railroad with rail-served waste transfer and recycling facilities in New Jersey. The investment provides growth capital for an integrated regional rail-and-environmental-logistics platform.

records.title: Great Sea Interconnector | Meridiam
records.description: Meridiam signed an agreement to become the majority shareholder of the Great Sea Interconnector SPV. The approximately €1.9bn, c.900 km subsea link is designed to transfer 1,000 MW between Greece and Cyprus and end Cyprus’ electrical isolation.

records.title: Maverick Water Group | Apollo
records.description: Apollo-managed funds acquired Maverick Water Group from Crosstimbers-managed funds, with management retaining a minority stake. Maverick develops, owns and operates long-term contracted non-potable water systems for communities, data centers and industrial customers across Texas.

records.title: MP Power | EQT Infrastructure
records.description: EQT Infrastructure-backed Osmose acquired MP Power, an Ely-based provider of overhead-line inspection, pole assessment, cable-condition and clearance services to UK electricity network operators. The bolt-on expands Osmose’s utility-infrastructure assessment capabilities in Europe.

records.title: Fallowfield Campus Student Accommodation | Equitix
records.description: Equitix and GRAHAM reached financial close on a £530mm, 50-year partnership with the University of Manchester to redevelop the Fallowfield campus. The project will deliver 3,300 student rooms in what the partners describe as the world’s largest single-phase Passivhaus student-accommodation scheme.

records.title: MBI | Basalt Infrastructure Partners
records.description: Basalt-advised funds acquired MBI from Fortress-managed funds; Basalt announced the transaction on August 3 after its July 31 closing. MBI operates more than 5,000 long-lived specialized assets and serves waste operators and municipalities across more than 40 terminals nationwide.

records.title: Momentum Midstream (M6) | EnCap Flatrock Midstream
records.description: Williams agreed to acquire 100% of EnCap Flatrock-backed Momentum Midstream for US$3.5bn in cash and assumed debt plus approximately US$2bn in Williams equity, for total consideration of up to US$5.5bn. The system spans more than 4,000 miles and connects Haynesville production to Gulf Coast LNG and power demand.
